scripts.script:
--[[
	WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
--[[
	WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
--[[
	WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
	local UIS              = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
	local Lighting         = game:GetService("Lighting")
	local TeleportService  = game:GetService("TeleportService")
	local player           = Players.LocalPlayer

	local DISCORD_URL = "https://discord.gg/Qe9Z2zX2G"
	local GATE_SECONDS = 15

	local uc = {
		Panel     = Color3.fromRGB(10, 8, 8),
		Surface   = Color3.fromRGB(24, 10, 10),
		SurfaceHi = Color3.fromRGB(38, 14, 14),
		Border    = Color3.fromRGB(96, 28, 28),
		Text      = Color3.fromRGB(245, 235, 235),
		Muted     = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 120),
		On        = Color3.fromRGB(220, 55, 55),
		Discord   = Color3.fromRGB(200, 35, 35),
	}

	local function make(className, props, parent)
		local inst = Instance.new(className)
		for k, v in pairs(props) do inst[k] = v end
		inst.Parent = parent
		return inst
	end

	local function corner(parent, radius)
		make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) }, parent)
	end

	local function copyDiscord()
		local ok = pcall(function()
			if setclipboard then
				setclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
			elseif toclipboard then
				toclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
			end
		end)
		return ok
	end

	-- ---------- feature state ----------
	local infJumpConn, noclipConn, flyConn, flyBV
	local savedLighting
	local savedSpeed, savedJumpPower, savedUseJumpPower
	local speedBoostOn, jumpPowerOn = false, false

	local function setInfiniteJump(on)
		if infJumpConn then infJumpConn:Disconnect(); infJumpConn = nil end
		if not on then return end
		infJumpConn = UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
			local char = player.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			end
		end)
	end

	local function setNoclip(on)
		if noclipConn then noclipConn:Disconnect(); noclipConn = nil end
		if not on then return end
		noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
			local char = player.Character
			if not char then return end
			for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
					p.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local function setFullbright(on)
		if on then
			if not savedLighting then
				savedLighting = {
					Brightness     = Lighting.Brightness,
					ClockTime      = Lighting.ClockTime,
					Ambient        = Lighting.Ambient,
					OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
					FogEnd         = Lighting.FogEnd,
					GlobalShadows  = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
				}
			end
			Lighting.Brightness     = 3
			Lighting.ClockTime      = 14
			Lighting.Ambient        = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
			Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
			Lighting.FogEnd         = 1e6
			Lighting.GlobalShadows  = false
		elseif savedLighting then
			for k, v in pairs(savedLighting) do
				pcall(function() Lighting[k] = v end)
			end
			savedLighting = nil
		end
	end

	local function setFly(on)
		if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect(); flyConn = nil end
		if flyBV   then flyBV:Destroy();      flyBV   = nil end
		if not on then return end
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = hum and hum.RootPart
		if not root then return end
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "HackingBrosFly"
		bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
		bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		bv.Parent = root
		flyBV = bv
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		flyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			if not flyBV or not flyBV.Parent then return end
			local dir = Vector3.zero
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W)           then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.LookVector   end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S)           then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.LookVector   end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A)           then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.RightVector  end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D)           then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.RightVector  end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)       then dir = dir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)    end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then dir = dir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)    end
			flyBV.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0 and dir.Unit * 60 or Vector3.zero
		end)
	end

	local function setSpeedBoost(on)
		speedBoostOn = on
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum then return end
		if on then
			if savedSpeed == nil then savedSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed end
			hum.WalkSpeed = 100
		elseif savedSpeed ~= nil then
			hum.WalkSpeed = savedSpeed
			savedSpeed = nil
		end
	end

	local function setJumpPower(on)
		jumpPowerOn = on
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum then return end
		if on then
			if savedJumpPower == nil then
				savedJumpPower    = hum.JumpPower
				savedUseJumpPower = hum.UseJumpPower
			end
			hum.UseJumpPower = true
			hum.JumpPower    = 120
		elseif savedJumpPower ~= nil then
			hum.JumpPower     = savedJumpPower
			hum.UseJumpPower  = savedUseJumpPower
			savedJumpPower    = nil
			savedUseJumpPower = nil
		end
	end

	local function resetCharacter()
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then hum.Health = 0 end
	end

	local function rejoinServer()
		pcall(function()
			TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, player)
		end)
	end

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
		if not hum then return end
		if speedBoostOn then hum.WalkSpeed = 100 end
		if jumpPowerOn then
			hum.UseJumpPower = true
			hum.JumpPower    = 120
		end
	end)

	-- =========================================================
	-- SPLASH — 15 second Discord gate
	-- =========================================================
	local function showSplash(onDone)
		local splash = make("ScreenGui", {
			Name = "HackingBrosSplash",
			ResetOnSpawn = false,
			IgnoreGuiInset = true,
			DisplayOrder = 200,
		}, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))

		make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
		}, splash)

		local card = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(460, 300),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			BackgroundColor3 = uc.Panel,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
		}, splash)
		corner(card, 14)
		make("UIStroke", { Color = uc.Border, Thickness = 1 }, card)

		make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 26),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 22),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "HACKING BROS",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 20,
			TextColor3 = uc.On,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, card)

		make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 16),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 50),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "FULL SCRIPT · JOIN DISCORD",
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextSize = 11,
			TextColor3 = uc.On,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, card)

		make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 60),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 76),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "Copy the invite link and hop in for the full release. The free UI below unlocks once the timer runs out.",
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextSize = 13,
			TextColor3 = uc.Muted,
			TextWrapped = true,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
		}, card)

		local linkBox = make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 38),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 148),
			BackgroundColor3 = uc.Surface,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Text = "discord.gg/Qe9Z2zX2G",
			Font = Enum.Font.Code,
			TextSize = 14,
			TextColor3 = uc.Text,
		}, card)
		corner(linkBox, 8)
		make("UIStroke", { Color = uc.Border, Thickness = 1 }, linkBox)

		local copyBtn = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 40),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 198),
			BackgroundColor3 = uc.Discord,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Text = "Copy Discord Invite",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 14,
			TextColor3 = uc.Text,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
		}, card)
		corner(copyBtn, 8)

		copyBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			copyDiscord()
			copyBtn.Text = "Copied — see you inside ✓"
			copyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = uc.On
			copyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		end)

		local countdown = make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 20),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, -38),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = ("UI unlocks in %ds…"):format(GATE_SECONDS),
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextSize = 12,
			TextColor3 = uc.Muted,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, card)

		local start = os.clock()
		task.spawn(function()
			while true do
				local remaining = math.max(0, math.ceil(GATE_SECONDS - (os.clock() - start)))
				countdown.Text = ("UI unlocks in %ds…"):format(remaining)
				if remaining <= 0 then break end
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
			splash:Destroy()
			onDone()
		end)
	end

	-- =========================================================
	-- MAIN UI
	-- =========================================================
	local function buildUI()
		local screen2 = make("ScreenGui", {
			Name = "HackingBrosGui",
			ResetOnSpawn = false,
			ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
			DisplayOrder = 101,
		}, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))

		-- -- persistent Discord button (top-right of screen)
		local dcBar = make("Frame", {
			Name = "DiscordBar",
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 40),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = uc.Panel,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
		}, screen2)
		corner(dcBar, 8)
		make("UIStroke", { Color = uc.Discord, Thickness = 1 }, dcBar)

		local dcBtn = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
		}, dcBar)

		local dcLabel = make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "Join DC for full script",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 13,
			TextColor3 = uc.Text,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, dcBtn)

		make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0.5, -9),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "›",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 16,
			TextColor3 = uc.On,
		}, dcBtn)

		dcBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			copyDiscord()
			dcLabel.Text = "Link copied ✓"
			task.delay(1.4, function()
				if dcLabel.Parent then
					dcLabel.Text = "Join DC for full script"
				end
			end)
		end)

		-- -- main panel
		local PANEL_W, PANEL_H = 340, 360

		local panel2 = make("Frame", {
			Name = "Panel",
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, PANEL_H),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			BackgroundColor3 = uc.Panel,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Active = true,
		}, screen2)
		corner(panel2, 10)
		make("UIStroke", { Color = uc.Border, Thickness = 1 }, panel2)

		local header2 = make("Frame", {
			Name = "Header",
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Active = true,
		}, panel2)

		make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 1, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "HACKING BROS",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 14,
			TextColor3 = uc.On,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, header2)

		local minBtn = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0, 12),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "–",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 20,
			TextColor3 = uc.Muted,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
		}, header2)

		local close2 = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -42, 0, 12),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "×",
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextSize = 22,
			TextColor3 = uc.Muted,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
		}, header2)

		make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 1),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 48),
			BackgroundColor3 = uc.Border,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
		}, panel2)

		local content = make("Frame", {
			Name = "Content",
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 1, -60),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 56),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		}, panel2)
		make("UIListLayout", {
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 5),
		}, content)

		local function makeToggle(order, label, callback)
			local btn = make("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
				BackgroundColor3 = uc.Surface,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Text = "",
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				LayoutOrder = order,
			}, content)
			corner(btn, 6)
			local stroke = make("UIStroke", { Color = uc.Border, Thickness = 1 }, btn)

			make("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = label,
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
				TextSize = 13,
				TextColor3 = uc.Text,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			}, btn)

			local status = make("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(0.3, -14, 1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = "OFF",
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				TextSize = 12,
				TextColor3 = uc.Muted,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
			}, btn)

			local state = false
			local function render()
				status.Text = state and "ON" or "OFF"
				status.TextColor3 = state and uc.On or uc.Muted
				stroke.Color = state and uc.On or uc.Border
				btn.BackgroundColor3 = state and uc.SurfaceHi or uc.Surface
			end
			render()

			btn.Activated:Connect(function()
				state = not state
				render()
				local ok, err = pcall(callback, state)
				if not ok then
					warn("[HackingBros] " .. label .. ": " .. tostring(err))
					state = false
					render()
				end
			end)
			return btn
		end

		local function makeAction(order, label, callback)
			local btn = make("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
				BackgroundColor3 = uc.Surface,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Text = "",
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				LayoutOrder = order,
			}, content)
			corner(btn, 6)
			make("UIStroke", { Color = uc.Border, Thickness = 1 }, btn)

			make("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = label,
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
				TextSize = 13,
				TextColor3 = uc.Text,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			}, btn)

			make("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
				Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.5, -10),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = "›",
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				TextSize = 16,
				TextColor3 = uc.On,
			}, btn)

			btn.Activated:Connect(function()
				pcall(callback)
			end)
			return btn
		end

		makeToggle(1, "Infinite Jump",            setInfiniteJump)
		makeToggle(2, "Noclip",                   setNoclip)
		makeToggle(3, "Fullbright",               setFullbright)
		makeToggle(4, "Fly  (WASD/Space/Ctrl)",   setFly)
		makeToggle(5, "Speed Boost",              setSpeedBoost)
		makeToggle(6, "High Jump",                setJumpPower)
		makeAction(7, "Reset Character",          resetCharacter)
		makeAction(8, "Rejoin Server",            rejoinServer)

		local minimized = false
		minBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			minimized = not minimized
			if minimized then
				content.Visible = false
				panel2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, 48)
				minBtn.Text = "+"
			else
				content.Visible = true
				panel2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, PANEL_H)
				minBtn.Text = "–"
			end
		end)

		close2.Activated:Connect(function()
			if infJumpConn then infJumpConn:Disconnect(); infJumpConn = nil end
			if noclipConn  then noclipConn:Disconnect();  noclipConn  = nil end
			if flyConn     then flyConn:Disconnect();     flyConn     = nil end
			if flyBV       then flyBV:Destroy();          flyBV       = nil end
			setFullbright(false)
			screen2:Destroy()
		end)

		-- -- drag
		local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
		header2.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging  = true
				dragInput = input
				dragStart = input.Position
				startPos  = panel2.Position
			end
		end)
		UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if dragging and (input == dragInput
				or (dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)) then
				local delta = input.Position - dragStart
				panel2.Position = UDim2.new(
					startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
					startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
				)
			end
		end)
		UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input == dragInput then
				dragging  = false
				dragInput = nil
			end
		end)

		return screen2
	end

	-- =========================================================
	-- RUN
	-- =========================================================
	showSplash(function()
		local ok, err = pcall(buildUI)
		if not ok then
			warn("[HackingBros] failed to build UI: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end)
end

scripts.features:
The GANG PANEL is a Roblox script that allows players to copy other players' skins.
It features a stylish interface with purple, pink, and gold colors.
A key system is required to access the panel.
It allows users to copy, save, import, and load skins with their animations.
A 3D preview lets users view and rotate their skins.
The settings include automatic copying and other customization options.

scripts.script:
-- Rayfield UI - Original Standard Tool Loader (Updated Arsenal)
local success, Rayfield = pcall(function()
    return loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()
end)

if not success or not Rayfield then
    Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shlexware/Rayfield/main/source'))()
end

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "Ultimate Sword Arsenal",
   LoadingTitle = "Delta Executor",
   LoadingSubtitle = "Original Standard Tools",
   ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
   Discord = { Enabled = false },
   KeySystem = false
})

local Tab = Window:CreateTab("Main", 4483362458)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local SWORD_ASSETS = {
    ["Azure Sword"] = 10288498712,
    ["Sword Coil"] = 124393086297115,
    ["Overseer's Sword"] = 52045984,
    ["Rainbow Star Sword"] = 8287295251,
    ["Bloodlust Demon Sword"] = 256836794,
    ["Sword Mesh"] = 10001892703,
    ["Error Sword"] = 12151969733,
    ["Crowbar Weapon"] = 118433966457105,
    ["Scythe"] = 126015814826887,
    ["Water Sword"] = 9156439687,
    ["Classic Delete Tool"] = 3205241096,
    ["Trowel"] = 9016251
}

local selectedSwordName = "Azure Sword"
local isOn = false
local currentTool = nil

local function removeSword()
    if currentTool then
        currentTool:Destroy()
        currentTool = nil
    end
end

local function giveSwordTool()
    removeSword()

    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    if not character or not backpack then return end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end

    local assetId = SWORD_ASSETS[selectedSwordName]
    if not assetId then return end

    local success, objects = pcall(function()
        return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId))
    end)

    if not success or not objects or #objects == 0 then
        pcall(function()
            objects = game:GetObjects("https://assetdelivery.roblox.com/v1/asset?id=" .. tostring(assetId))
        end)
    end

    local tool
    if success and objects and #objects > 0 then
        local rawObject = objects[1]
        if rawObject:IsA("Tool") then
            tool = rawObject
        else
            tool = Instance.new("Tool")
            tool.Name = selectedSwordName
            rawObject.Parent = tool
        end
    else
        tool = Instance.new("Tool")
        tool.Name = selectedSwordName
        local handle = Instance.new("Part")
        handle.Name = "Handle"
        handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 4, 0.6)
        handle.Parent = tool
    end

    local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") or tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    if not handle then
        handle = Instance.new("Part")
        handle.Name = "Handle"
        handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 4, 0.6)
        handle.Parent = tool
    else
        handle.Name = "Handle"
    end

    for _, part in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.CanCollide = false
        end
    end

    currentTool = tool
    tool.Parent = backpack

    task.wait(0.1)
    if tool.Parent == backpack and humanoid then
        humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
    end
end

-- runs a block safely so one broken feature can't stop the gui

    local o = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end

    return o
end
local function corner(o, r)
    return new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r)}, o)
end
local function gradient(o, rot)
    return new("UIGradient", {

local function tween(o, t, props)
    TS:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()

-- ============ SAFE MOUNT ============
local function mount(g)
    if syn and syn.protect_gui then pcall(syn.protect_gui, g) end
    local targets = {}
    if gethui then table.insert(targets, function() return gethui() end) end
    table.insert(targets, function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
    table.insert(targets, function() return LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5) end)
    for _, fn in ipairs(targets) do
        local ok, p = pcall(fn)
        if ok and p then
            local ok2 = pcall(function() g.Parent = p end)
            if ok2 and g.Parent == p then return p end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- ============ DRAG ============
local function drag(frame, grip)

    local dragging, start, startPos = false, nil, nil
    track(grip.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging, start, startPos = true, i.Position, frame.Position
        end
    end))
    track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if not dragging then return end
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            local d = i.Position - start
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
                                       startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end))
    track(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)

local function getRoot()

local function isRemote(d)
    return d:IsA("RemoteEvent") or d:IsA("RemoteFunction") or d:IsA("BindableEvent")
end

local function findRemote(names)
    local pool = {}
    for _, n in ipairs(names) do
        local hit = RS:FindFirstChild(n, true) or WS:FindFirstChild(n, true)
        if hit then table.insert(pool, hit) end
    end
    local rake = WS:FindFirstChild("the_rake", true)
    if rake then
        for _, d in ipairs(rake:GetDescendants()) do
            if isRemote(d) then table.insert(pool, d) end
        end
    end
    for _, d in ipairs(RS:GetDescendants()) do
        if isRemote(d) and d.Name:lower():find("startmode") then
            table.insert(pool, d)
        end
    end
    return pool
end

section("move", function()
    -- ---- FLY ----
    local flyOn, flyCon, flyBV, flyBG = false, nil, nil, nil
    stopFly = function()
        flyOn = false
        if flyCon then flyCon:Disconnect(); flyCon = nil end
        if flyBV then flyBV:Destroy(); flyBV = nil end
        if flyBG then flyBG:Destroy(); flyBG = nil end
    end

    local setFlyUI
    local function startFly()
        local root = getRoot()
        if not root then return false end
        flyOn = true
        flyBV = new("BodyVelocity", {MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5), Velocity = Vector3.zero}, root)
        flyBG = new("BodyGyro", {MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5), P = 1000, CFrame = root.CFrame}, root)
        flyCon = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local r = getRoot()
            local cm = WS.CurrentCamera
            if not r or not cm or not flyOn then return end
            local dir = Vector3.zero
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir = dir + cm.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir = dir - cm.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir = dir - cm.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir = dir + cm.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir = dir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then dir = dir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
            if dir.Magnitude > 0 then dir = dir.Unit * 60 end
            if flyBV then flyBV.Velocity = dir end
            if flyBG then flyBG.CFrame = cm.CFrame end
        end)
        track(flyCon)
        return true
    end

    label(pMove, "Movement")
    setFlyUI = toggle(pMove, "Fly  (WASD / Space / Shift)", function(v)
        if v then
            if not startFly() then setFlyUI(false, true) end
        else
            stopFly()
        end

    track(LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        stopFly()
        setFlyUI(false, true)
    end))

    -- ---- SPEED ----

    track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

        local _, hum = getRoot()

    end))

    -- ---- INFINITE STAMINA ----

    local function getStaminaRemote()

        return pr and pr:FindFirstChild("SetStaminaValues")
    end

    local function fireStamina()
        local Event = getStaminaRemote()
        if not Event then return false end
        firesignal(Event.OnClientEvent,
            100,
            15,
            42,
            999999
        )
        return true
    end

    local setStaminaUI
    setStaminaUI = toggle(pMove, "Infinite Stamina", function(v)
        if not v then
            if staminaCon then staminaCon:Disconnect(); staminaCon = nil end
            return
        end
        if not firesignal then
            notify("Your executor has no firesignal")

section("sky", function()
    label(pMove, "Sky")
    local skyHeight   = 500
    local skyPlatform = nil
    local skyReturnCF = nil

    removePlatform = function()
        if skyPlatform then
            pcall(function() skyPlatform:Destroy() end)
            skyPlatform = nil
        end
    end

    local function makePlatform(cf)
        removePlatform()
        local p = new("Part", {
            Name = tostring(math.random(100000, 999999)),
            Size = Vector3.new(60, 2, 60),
            Anchored = true,
            CanCollide = true,
            Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
            Color = C.a1,
            Transparency = 0.35,
            TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
            BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
            CFrame = cf,
        }, WS)
        new("SelectionBox", {
            Adornee = p,
            LineThickness = 0.08,
            Color3 = C.a2,
            SurfaceTransparency = 1,
        }, p)
        new("PointLight", {Color = C.a2, Range = 30, Brightness = 2}, p)
        -- slow pulse so it looks alive
        TS:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
            {Transparency = 0.6}):Play()

        end

        removePlatform()
    end)

section("combat", function()
    -- ---- DROPS DATA ----
    -- add more drops here. "id" is the debug id from your snippet; debug ids
    -- change between sessions, so if the exact id isn't found it falls back
    -- to the first nil instance with that name.
    local DROPS = {
        {name = "Coin",       id = "1_200886"},
        {name = "TrainerCap", id = "1_239393"},
    }
    local dropChance = 25

    local function getNil(name, debugId)
        if not getnilinstances then return nil end
        for _, o in ipairs(getnilinstances()) do
            if o.Name == name then
                if not debugId or o:GetDebugId() == debugId then
                    return o
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local nilCache = {}
    local function resolveDrop(d)
        if nilCache[d.name] then return nilCache[d.name] end
        local inst = getNil(d.name, d.id) or getNil(d.name)
        nilCache[d.name] = inst
        return inst
    end

    local function posOf(o)
        if typeof(o) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
        local ok, p = pcall(function()
            if o:IsA("BasePart") then return o.Position end
            if o:IsA("Model") then return o:GetPivot().Position end
            if o:IsA("Tool") then
                local h = o:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                return h and h.Position
            end
        end)
        return ok and p or nil
    end

    local function tpTo(p, fromDrop)
        local root = getRoot()
        if root and p then
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(p + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
            if fromDrop then aiPauseUntil = tick() + 1.5 end
        end
    end

    -- fires the SpawnDrop signal with the nil instance, like your snippets
    local function spawnDrop(d)
        local ev = RS:FindFirstChild("SpawnDrop")
        if not ev then notify("SpawnDrop remote not found") return false end
        if not firesignal then notify("Your executor has no firesignal") return false end
        local inst = resolveDrop(d)
        if not inst then
            notify("Couldn't find '" .. d.name .. "' (needs getnilinstances)")
            return false
        end
        firesignal(ev.OnClientEvent, inst)
        return true
    end

    -- picks a random drop, fires it, then teleports to where it appeared
    local function rollDrop(fallbackPos)
        local d = DROPS[math.random(#DROPS)]
        local found
        local c = WS.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(o)
            if o.Name == d.name then found = o end
        end)
        local ok = spawnDrop(d)
        task.wait(0.3)
        c:Disconnect()
        if ok and tpDrop then
            tpTo(posOf(found) or fallbackPos, true)
        end
    end

    -- teleport to drops the game spawns by itself
    local dropConn = nil
    local function bindDropListener()
        if dropConn then return true end
        local ev = RS:FindFirstChild("SpawnDrop")
        if not ev then return false end
        dropConn = ev.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(obj)
            if not tpDrop then return end
            if typeof(obj) ~= "Instance" or not obj:IsDescendantOf(WS) then return end
            task.wait(0.1)
            tpTo(posOf(obj), true)
        end)
        track(dropConn)
        return true
    end

    -- watches enemies and rolls a drop when one dies
    local hooked = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local function hookEnemy(m, hum)
        if hooked[m] then return end
        hooked[m] = true
        if hum.Health <= 0 then return end
        track(hum.Died:Connect(function()
            if not dropsOn then return end
            if math.random() * 100 > dropChance then return end
            local ok, pos = pcall(function() return m:GetPivot().Position end)
            task.spawn(rollDrop, ok and pos or nil)
        end))
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while alive do
            task.wait(1)
            if dropsOn then
                for _, m in ipairs(WS:GetChildren()) do
                    if m:IsA("Model") and m ~= LP.Character
                    and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) == nil then
                        local mh = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if mh then hookEnemy(m, mh) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- ---- TARGETING (shared by Auto Rakoof, Aim Lock, Hitbox, Teleport to Rakoof) ----
    local aiTeleport, limitRange, hitRange, preferRakoof = true, false, 60, true

    local function validTarget(m)
        if not m or not m.Parent then return false end
        local h = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if h and h.Health <= 0 then return false end
        return true
    end

    local function partOf(m)
        return m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or m.PrimaryPart
            or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    end

    -- looks through a list for a model named like "rakoof"
    -- (falls back to a living "rake" model with a Humanoid, e.g. the_rake)
    local function scan(list)
        local fallback
        for _, d in ipairs(list) do
            if d:IsA("Model") and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(d) then
                local h = d:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not h or h.Health > 0 then
                    local n = d.Name:lower()
                    if n:find("rakoof") then
                        return d
                    elseif not fallback and h and n:find("rake") then
                        fallback = d
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return fallback
    end

    local rakoofCache, lastDeep = nil, 0
    local function getRakoof()
        if validTarget(rakoofCache) then return rakoofCache end
        rakoofCache = scan(WS:GetChildren())
        if not rakoofCache and tick() - lastDeep > 2 then
            lastDeep = tick()
            rakoofCache = scan(WS:GetDescendants())
        end
        return rakoofCache
    end

    local function nearestEnemy(root, useLimit)
        local best, bestPart, bestD = nil, nil, math.huge
        for _, m in ipairs(WS:GetChildren()) do
            if m:IsA("Model") and m ~= LP.Character then
                local mh = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local mr = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if mh and mr and mh.Health > 0 and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) == nil then
                    local d = (mr.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                    if (not useLimit or d <= hitRange) and d < bestD then
                        bestD, best, bestPart = d, m, mr
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best, bestPart
    end

    local function pickTarget(root, useLimit)
        if preferRakoof then
            local rk = getRakoof()
            local rp = rk and partOf(rk)
            if rp and (not useLimit or (rp.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= hitRange) then
                return rk, rp
            end
        end
        return nearestEnemy(root, useLimit)
    end

    -- ---- AUTO RAKOOF ----
    label(pCombat, "Auto Rakoof")
    local aiCon = nil

    toggle(pCombat, "Auto Rakoof", function(v)
        aiOn = v
        if aiCon then aiCon:Disconnect(); aiCon = nil end
        if not v then return end
        aiCon = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if tick() < aiPauseUntil then return end
            local char = LP.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root then return end

            local m, mr = pickTarget(root, limitRange)
            if not m or not mr then return end

            if aiTeleport then
                local target = mr.Position + (mr.CFrame.LookVector * -1) * standDist + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(target, mr.Position)
            end
            local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if tool then pcall(function() tool:Activate() end) end
        end)
        track(aiCon)
    end)

    local setRF = toggle(pCombat, "Rakoof First", function(v) preferRakoof = v end)
    setRF(true)
    local setTPEnemy = toggle(pCombat, "Teleport to Enemy", function(v) aiTeleport = v end)
    setTPEnemy(true)
    toggle(pCombat, "Limit Hit Range", function(v) limitRange = v end)
    slider(pCombat, "Hit Range (studs)", 5, 500, hitRange, function(v) hitRange = v end)
    slider(pCombat, "Stand Distance", 3, 20, standDist, function(v) standDist = v end)

    -- ---- RAKOOF HITBOX ----
    label(pCombat, "Rakoof Hitbox")
    local hbOn, hbAll, hbShow, hbSize = false, false, true, 25
    local hbOriginal = {}   -- [part] = original properties
    local hbModel = nil

    local function hbRestore()
        for part, o in pairs(hbOriginal) do
            if part and part.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    part.Size = o.Size
                    part.Transparency = o.Transparency
                    part.CanCollide = o.CanCollide
                    part.Massless = o.Massless
                end)
            end
        end
        hbOriginal = {}
        hbModel = nil
    end
    restoreHitbox = hbRestore

    local function hbApply(part)
        if not hbOriginal[part] then
            hbOriginal[part] = {
                Size = part.Size,
                Transparency = part.Transparency,
                CanCollide = part.CanCollide,
                Massless = part.Massless,
            }
        end
        local o = hbOriginal[part]
        local want = o.Size + Vector3.new(hbSize, hbSize, hbSize)
        if part.Size ~= want then part.Size = want end
        part.CanCollide = false
        part.Massless = true
        part.Transparency = hbShow and math.max(0.55, o.Transparency) or o.Transparency
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while alive do
            task.wait(0.25)
            if hbOn then
                local m = getRakoof()
                if m then
                    if hbModel ~= m then
                        hbRestore()
                        hbModel = m
                    end
                    if hbAll then
                        for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
                            if p:IsA("BasePart") then pcall(hbApply, p) end
                        end
                    else
                        local rp = partOf(m)
                        if rp then pcall(hbApply, rp) end
                    end
                elseif hbModel then
                    hbRestore() -- Rakoof is gone
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    toggle(pCombat, "Expand Rakoof Hitbox", function(v)
        hbOn = v
        if not v then
            hbRestore()
            return
        end
        if not getRakoof() then
            notify("Rakoof not found yet - will apply when he spawns")
        end
    end)
    slider(pCombat, "Hitbox Size", 1, 100, hbSize, function(v) hbSize = v end)
    local setHbShow = toggle(pCombat, "Show Hitbox", function(v)
        hbShow = v
        if hbOn then hbRestore() end -- reapplies with the new look next tick
    end)
    setHbShow(true)
    toggle(pCombat, "All Parts", function(v)
        hbAll = v
        if hbOn then hbRestore() end -- reapplies for the new mode next tick
    end)

    -- ---- AIM LOCK ----
    label(pCombat, "Aim Lock")
    local aimStrength, aimHead = 100, false
    local aimTarget, aimPart, aimAt = nil, nil, 0
    local AIM_BIND = "eva_aim_" .. tostring(math.random(1000, 9999))

    local function aimStep()
        local cm = WS.CurrentCamera
        local root = getRoot()
        if not cm or not root then return end
        -- re-pick the target a few times a second instead of every frame
        if tick() - aimAt > 0.25 or not (aimPart and aimPart.Parent) then
            aimAt = tick()
            aimTarget, aimPart = pickTarget(root, false)
        end
        if not aimPart then return end
        local pos = aimPart.Position
        if aimHead and aimTarget then
            local h = aimTarget:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if h and h:IsA("BasePart") then pos = h.Position end
        end
        local goal = CFrame.new(cm.CFrame.Position, pos)
        local a = aimStrength / 100
        cm.CFrame = (a >= 1) and goal or cm.CFrame:Lerp(goal, a)
    end

    stopAim = function()
        aimOn = false
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(AIM_BIND) end)
    end

    toggle(pCombat, "Aim Lock (Rakoof)", function(v)
        stopAim()
        if not v then return end
        aimOn = true
        aimAt = 0
        local ok = pcall(function()
            RunService:BindToRenderStep(AIM_BIND, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, aimStep)
        end)
        if ok then
            notify("Aim lock on")
        else
            aimOn = false
            notify("Aim lock failed to start")
        end
    end)
    slider(pCombat, "Lock Strength", 5, 100, aimStrength, function(v) aimStrength = v end)
    toggle(pCombat, "Aim at Head", function(v) aimHead = v end)

    -- ---- TELEPORT ----
    label(pCombat, "Teleport")
    button(pCombat, "Teleport to Rakoof", function()
        local m = getRakoof()
        if not m then notify("Rakoof not found") return end
        local root = getRoot()
        if not root then return end
        local ok, cf = pcall(function() return m:GetPivot() end)
        if not ok then notify("Couldn't read Rakoof's position") return end
        local target = cf.Position + (cf.LookVector * -1) * standDist + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(target, cf.Position)
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        aiPauseUntil = tick() + 1.5
    end)

    -- ---- DROPS UI ----
    label(pCombat, "Drops")
    toggle(pCombat, "Enemy Drops", function(v) dropsOn = v end)
    slider(pCombat, "Drop Chance %", 0, 100, dropChance, function(v) dropChance = v end)

    toggle(pCombat, "Teleport to Drops", function(v)
        tpDrop = v
        if v and not bindDropListener() then
            notify("SpawnDrop not found - only enemy drops teleport")
        end
    end)

    button(pCombat, "Spawn Random Drop Now", function()
        local root = getRoot()
        task.spawn(rollDrop, root and root.Position or nil)
    end)

    -- ---- AUTO PICKUP + AUTO CANDY ----
    label(pCombat, "Automation")

    local function touch(root, part)
        if firetouchinterest then
            pcall(firetouchinterest, root, part, 0)
            pcall(firetouchinterest, root, part, 1)
        elseif not part.Anchored then
            pcall(function() part.CFrame = root.CFrame end)
        end
    end

    -- picks up tools plus parts named drop / coin / item
    toggle(pCombat, "Auto Pickup", function(v)
        pickupOn = v
        if not v then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            while pickupOn and alive do
                local root = getRoot()
                if root then
                    for _, o in ipairs(WS:GetDescendants()) do
                        if not pickupOn then break end
                        local part
                        if o:IsA("Tool") then
                            part = o:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                        elseif o:IsA("BasePart") then
                            local n = o.Name:lower()
                            if n:find("drop") or n:find("coin") or n:find("item") then
                                part = o
                            end

    table.insert(MasterConnections, conn)

local function RegisterPlayerConnection(player, conn)
    if not PlayerConnections[player] then
        PlayerConnections[player] = {}
    end
    table.insert(PlayerConnections[player], conn)
    table.insert(MasterConnections, conn)
    return conn
end

local function CleanupPlayerConnections(player)
    local conns = PlayerConnections[player]
    if conns then
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
        end
        PlayerConnections[player] = nil
    end
end

local function CleanupAllConnections()
    for _, c in ipairs(MasterConnections) do
        if typeof(c) == "RBXScriptConnection" and c.Connected then

-- ============================================================
-- ESP MODULE (Players) — PATCHED
-- ============================================================

local ESPModule = {}

function ESPModule:CreateESP(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end
    if ESPObjects[player] then self:RemoveESP(player) end

    local espData = {}

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Name = "ESP_Billboard"
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 60)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, ESPYOffset, 0)
    billboard.LightInfluence = 0
    billboard.MaxDistance = 2000

    local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    nameLabel.Name = "NameLabel"
    nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.35, 0)
    nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    nameLabel.TextSize = ESPFontSize
    nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
    nameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    nameLabel.Text = player.Name
    nameLabel.Parent = billboard

    local healthLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    healthLabel.Name = "HealthLabel"
    healthLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    healthLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.35, 0)
    healthLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.35, 0)
    healthLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    healthLabel.TextSize = ESPFontSize - 1
    healthLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
    healthLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
    healthLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    healthLabel.Text = "100 HP"
    healthLabel.Parent = billboard

    local distLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    distLabel.Name = "DistLabel"
    distLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    distLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.3, 0)
    distLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.7, 0)
    distLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    distLabel.TextSize = ESPFontSize - 2
    distLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    distLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
    distLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    distLabel.Text = "0m"
    distLabel.Parent = billboard

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
    highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    highlight.FillTransparency = ESPFillTransparency
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop

    espData.Billboard = billboard
    espData.Highlight = highlight
    espData.NameLabel = nameLabel
    espData.HealthLabel = healthLabel
    espData.DistLabel = distLabel

    ESPObjects[player] = espData
    self:AttachESP(player)

    -- PATCH #1: Clean up when character is removed (respawn/death)
    -- so we don't hold refs to destroyed instances
    if player.Character then
        local charRemovingConn
        charRemovingConn = player.Character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
            if parent == nil then
                -- Character was destroyed, detach GUI refs
                if espData.Billboard then
                    espData.Billboard.Adornee = nil
                    espData.Billboard.Parent = nil
                end
                if espData.Highlight and espData.Highlight.Parent then
                    espData.Highlight.Parent = nil
                end
                if charRemovingConn then
                    charRemovingConn:Disconnect()
                    charRemovingConn = nil
                end
            end
        end)
        RegisterPlayerConnection(player, charRemovingConn)
    end
end

function ESPModule:AttachESP(player)
    local espData = ESPObjects[player]
    if not espData then return end
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end

    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if head then
        espData.Billboard.Adornee = head
        espData.Billboard.Parent = head
    end

    -- PATCH: Verify highlight parent is valid before setting
    if char.Parent then
        espData.Highlight.Parent = char
    end
end

function ESPModule:RemoveESP(player)
    local espData = ESPObjects[player]
    if not espData then return end
    SafeDestroy(espData.Billboard)
    SafeDestroy(espData.Highlight)
    espData.Billboard = nil
    espData.Highlight = nil
    ESPObjects[player] = nil
end

function ESPModule:UpdateESP()
    for player, espData in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        -- PATCH #1: Validate player still exists
        if not player or not player.Parent then
            self:RemoveESP(player)
            continue
        end

        local char = player.Character
        if not char or not char.Parent then continue end

        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local myRoot = GetRootPart()

        if hum then
            local maxHP = math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1)
            local health = math.floor(hum.Health)
            local ratio = math.clamp(hum.Health / maxHP, 0, 1)
            espData.HealthLabel.Text = health .. "/" .. math.floor(maxHP) .. " HP"
            espData.HealthLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255 * (1 - ratio), 255 * ratio, 0)
        end

        if root and myRoot and ESPShowDistance then
            espData.DistLabel.Text = math.floor((root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude) .. "m"
            espData.DistLabel.Visible = true
        else
            espData.DistLabel.Visible = false
        end

        espData.Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, ESPYOffset, 0)
        espData.NameLabel.TextSize = ESPFontSize
        espData.HealthLabel.TextSize = ESPFontSize - 1
        espData.DistLabel.TextSize = ESPFontSize - 2

function NPCESPModule:Update()

        local data = NPCESPObjects[i]
        if not data.Model or not data.Model.Parent or not data.Humanoid or not data.Humanoid.Parent then
            SafeDestroy(data.Highlight)
            SafeDestroy(data.Billboard)

        else
            data.HealthLabel.Text = math.floor(data.Humanoid.Health) .. " HP"
        end

function NPCESPModule:Clear()
    for _, data in ipairs(NPCESPObjects) do
        SafeDestroy(data.Highlight)
        SafeDestroy(data.Billboard)
        if data.DestroyConn then data.DestroyConn:Disconnect(); data.DestroyConn = nil end
    end
    NPCESPObjects = {}

local FlyModule = {}

function FlyModule:Enable()
    local root = GetRootPart()
    local hum = GetHumanoid()
    if not root or not hum then return end

    -- PATCH #11: Clean old instances first
    self:Disable()

    FlyBody = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    FlyBody.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    FlyBody.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    FlyBody.Parent = root

    FlyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    FlyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    FlyGyro.P = 9e4
    FlyGyro.Parent = root

    hum.PlatformStand = true
end

function FlyModule:Disable()
    local hum = GetHumanoid()
    if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
    if FlyBody then SafeDestroy(FlyBody); FlyBody = nil end
    if FlyGyro then SafeDestroy(FlyGyro); FlyGyro = nil end
end

function FlyModule:Update()
    if not FlyEnabled then return end
    -- PATCH #11: Validate instances still exist and have parents
    if not FlyBody or not FlyBody.Parent or not FlyGyro or not FlyGyro.Parent then
        -- Re-enable if character is valid
        local root = GetRootPart()
        if root and root.Parent then
            self:Enable()
        end
        return
    end

    local root = GetRootPart()
    if not root or not root.Parent then return end

    local dir = Vector3.zero
    local cf = Camera.CFrame

    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += cf.LookVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= cf.LookVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= cf.RightVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += cf.RightVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end

    if dir.Magnitude > 0 then dir = dir.Unit end
    FlyBody.Velocity = dir * FlySpeed
    FlyGyro.CFrame = cf
end

    AimbotFOVCircle.Transparency = 0.7
    AimbotFOVCircle.Filled = false
    AimbotFOVCircle.NumSides = 64
end

-- PATCH #12: Centralized cleanup
function AimbotModule:DestroyFOVCircle()
    if AimbotFOVCircle then
        pcall(function() AimbotFOVCircle:Remove() end)
        AimbotFOVCircle = nil
    end
end

function AimbotModule:UpdateFOVCircle()
    if not AimbotFOVCircle then return end
    local mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    AimbotFOVCircle.Position = Vector2.new(mp.X, mp.Y)
    AimbotFOVCircle.Radius = AimbotFOV
    AimbotFOVCircle.Visible = AimbotEnabled
end

function AimbotModule:GetClosestPlayer()
    local closest, closestDist = nil, AimbotFOV
    local mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player == LocalPlayer or not IsAlive(player) or IsTeammate(player) then continue end
        local head = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then continue end
        local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
        if not onScreen then continue end
        local dist = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - mp).Magnitude
        if dist < closestDist then closestDist = dist; closest = player end
    end
    return closest
end

function AimbotModule:AimAt(player)
    if not player then return end
    local head = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then return end
    local camPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local targetCF = CFrame.lookAt(camPos, head.Position)
    Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(targetCF, 1 / AimbotSmoothing)
end

-- PATCH #7: Validate spectate target each frame
function SpectateModule:Validate()
    if not SpectateEnabled then return end
    if not SpectateTarget or not SpectateTarget.Parent then
        self:Disable()
        SpectateEnabled = false
        if Toggles and Toggles.SpectateToggle then
            Toggles.SpectateToggle:SetValue(false)
        end
        Notify("Spectate", "Target left, spectate disabled")
        return
    end
    if not SpectateTarget.Character or not SpectateTarget.Character.Parent then
        -- Character gone (respawning), just wait
        return
    end
    -- Validate beam attachments
    if SpectateBeamAtt1 and not IsValidInstance(SpectateBeamAtt1) then
        self:CreateBeam()
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- LOW HP TRACKER MODULE — PATCHED #3
-- ============================================================

local LowHPModule = {}

function LowHPModule:Enable()
    self:Disable()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then self:Watch(player) end
    end
end

function LowHPModule:Watch(player)
    if LowHPConnections[player] then return end -- already watching
    LowHPConnections[player] = {}
    LowHPCooldowns[player] = 0

    -- PATCH #3: Use CharacterAdded + HealthChanged instead of Heartbeat polling
    local function hookCharacter(char)
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
        if not hum then return end

        local healthConn
        healthConn = hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(newHealth)
            if not LowHPEnabled then return end
            if newHealth > 0 and newHealth < LowHPThreshold then
                local now = tick()
                if now - (LowHPCooldowns[player] or 0) > 5 then
                    LowHPCooldowns[player] = now
                    PlaySound(SoundLowHP, SoundVolume)
                    Notify("Low HP", player.Name .. " is at " .. math.floor(newHealth) .. " HP!", 2)
                end
            end
        end)

        if not LowHPConnections[player] then
            LowHPConnections[player] = {}
        end
        table.insert(LowHPConnections[player], healthConn)
    end

    -- Hook current character
    if player.Character then hookCharacter(player.Character) end

    -- Hook future characters
    local charAddedConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.wait(1)
        hookCharacter(char)
    end)
    table.insert(LowHPConnections[player], charAddedConn)
end

function LowHPModule:Unwatch(player)
    local conns = LowHPConnections[player]
    if conns then
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
        end
    end
    LowHPConnections[player] = nil
    LowHPCooldowns[player] = nil
end

function LowHPModule:Disable()
    for player in pairs(LowHPConnections) do
        self:Unwatch(player)
    end
    LowHPConnections = {}
    LowHPCooldowns = {}
end

-- ============================================================
-- DEATH LOGGER MODULE — PATCHED #4
-- ============================================================

local DeathLogModule = {}

function DeathLogModule:Enable()
    self:Disable()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        self:Watch(player)
    end
end

function DeathLogModule:Watch(player)
    -- PATCH #4: Prevent stacking connections
    if DeathConnections[player] then return end
    DeathConnections[player] = {}

    local function hookCharacter(char)
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
        if not hum then return end

        local diedConn
        diedConn = hum.Died:Connect(function()
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local pos = root and root.Position or Vector3.zero
            local isVoid = pos.Y < (Workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 50)
            local entry = {
                Player = player.Name,
                Position = pos,
                CFrame = root and root.CFrame or CFrame.new(),
                Time = os.date("%H:%M:%S"),
                IsVoid = isVoid,
            }
            table.insert(DeathLogs, 1, entry)
            -- PATCH #15: Cap death logs
            while #DeathLogs > 100 do
                table.remove(DeathLogs)
            end
            Notify("Death Log", player.Name .. " died at " .. entry.Time .. (isVoid and " (Void)" or ""), 4)
        end)

        if DeathConnections[player] then
            table.insert(DeathConnections[player], diedConn)
        end
    end

    if player.Character then hookCharacter(player.Character) end

    local charConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.wait(0.5)
        hookCharacter(char)
    end)
    table.insert(DeathConnections[player], charConn)
end

function DeathLogModule:Unwatch(player)
    local conns = DeathConnections[player]
    if conns then
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
        end
    end
    DeathConnections[player] = nil
end

function DeathLogModule:Disable()
    for player in pairs(DeathConnections) do
        self:Unwatch(player)
    end
    DeathConnections = {}
end

-- ============================================================
-- PLAYER ACTIVITY LOGGER — PATCHED #5, #14
-- ============================================================

local ActivityModule = {}

function ActivityModule:Enable()
    self:Disable()

    -- PATCH #14: Clear stale join times
    table.clear(PlayerJoinTimes)

    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        PlayerJoinTimes[p.UserId] = os.time()
    end

    local joinConn = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
        PlayerJoinTimes[p.UserId] = os.time()
    end)

    local leaveConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
        local joinTime = PlayerJoinTimes[p.UserId]
        local duration = joinTime and (os.time() - joinTime) or 0
        local mins = math.floor(duration / 60)
        local secs = duration % 60
        PlaySound(SoundLeft, SoundVolume)
        Notify("Player Left", string.format("%s left (Session: %dm %ds)", p.Name, mins, secs), 5)
        PlayerJoinTimes[p.UserId] = nil
    end)

    -- PATCH #5: Store named for proper cleanup
    ActivityConnections = {joinConn, leaveConn}
end

function ActivityModule:Disable()
    for _, c in ipairs(ActivityConnections) do
        if typeof(c) == "RBXScriptConnection" and c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
    end
    ActivityConnections = {}
    -- PATCH #14: Clear join times
    table.clear(PlayerJoinTimes)
end

-- ============================================================
-- INSTANCE PATH EVALUATOR — PATCHED #9
-- ============================================================

local function ClearInstanceHighlights()
    for i = #InstanceHighlights, 1, -1 do
        SafeDestroy(InstanceHighlights[i])
        InstanceHighlights[i] = nil
    end
    InstanceHighlights = {}
end

local function EvaluateInstancePath(pathStr)
    -- PATCH #9: Always clear before new evaluation
    ClearInstanceHighlights()

    local success, result = pcall(function()
        return loadstring("return " .. pathStr)()
    end)

    if not success then
        Notify("Evaluator", "Error: " .. tostring(result), 4)
        return
    end

    local parts = {}
    if typeof(result) == "Instance" then
        parts = {result}
    elseif type(result) == "table" then
        parts = result
    end

    local count = 0
    for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if typeof(part) == "Instance" and (part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Model")) then
            local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
            h.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
            h.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
            h.FillTransparency = 0.4
            h.OutlineTransparency = 0
            h.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            h.Parent = part
            table.insert(InstanceHighlights, h)
            count += 1
        end
    end
    Notify("Evaluator", "Highlighted " .. count .. " instances", 3)
end

-- ============================================================
-- WORKSPACE SCANNER
-- ============================================================

local function ScanWorkspace()
    local anchored, unanchored, tools, npcs, playerCount = 0, 0, 0, 0, #Players:GetPlayers()

    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            if obj.Anchored then anchored += 1 else unanchored += 1 end
        elseif obj:IsA("Tool") then
            tools += 1
        elseif obj:IsA("Humanoid") then
            local model = obj.Parent
            local isPlayer = false
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p.Character == model then isPlayer = true; break end
            end
            if not isPlayer then npcs += 1 end
        end
    end

    return string.format(
        "Anchored: %d\nUnanchored: %d\nTools: %d\nPlayers: %d\nNPCs: %d",
        anchored, unanchored, tools, playerCount, npcs
    )
end

-- PATCH #10: Generation counter to kill stale coroutines
ChatGroup:AddToggle("ChatSpamToggle", {
    Text = "Chat Spam",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        ChatSpamEnabled = v
        BumpTelemetry("TogglesUsed")
        if v then
            ChatSpamGeneration += 1
            local myGen = ChatSpamGeneration
            task.spawn(function()
                while ChatSpamEnabled and ChatSpamGeneration == myGen do
                    pcall(function()
                        local events = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
                        if events then
                            local say = events:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
                            if say then say:FireServer(ChatSpamMessage, "All") end
                        end
                    end)
                    task.wait(ChatSpamDelay)
                end
            end)
        else
            -- Bump generation to kill any running coroutine
            ChatSpamGeneration += 1
        end
    end
})

        if PotatoEnabled then DisablePotato() end

        -- World state
        if NoVoidEnabled and NoVoidOriginal then
            Workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = NoVoidOriginal
        end
        if CustomGravityEnabled then Workspace.Gravity = 196.2 end

        -- Tools
        if TPTool then SafeDestroy(TPTool); TPTool = nil end

        -- Instance highlights
        ClearInstanceHighlights()

        -- Character state
        local hum = GetHumanoid()
        if hum then
            hum.WalkSpeed = 16
            hum.JumpPower = 50
            hum.MaxSlopeAngle = 89
            if GodModeEnabled then
                hum.MaxHealth = 100
                hum.Health = 100
            end
        end

        -- Kill chat spam coroutine
        ChatSpamEnabled = false
        ChatSpamGeneration += 1

        -- Disconnect ALL registered connections
        CleanupAllConnections()

        -- Clear data tables
        table.clear(DeathLogs)
        table.clear(Waypoints)
        table.clear(LowHPCooldowns)

        Library:Unload()
        print("[persistence.win] Fully unloaded — all connections and instances cleaned up.")
    end
})

local SoundGroup = SettingsTab:AddLeftGroupbox("Sound Customization")

SoundGroup:AddInput("SoundLowHPInput", {
    Default = SoundLowHP,
    Numeric = false,
    Finished = true,
    Text = "Low HP Sound ID",
    Callback = function(v) SoundLowHP = v end
})

SoundGroup:AddInput("SoundLeftInput", {
    Default = SoundLeft,
    Numeric = false,
    Finished = true,
    Text = "Player Left Sound ID",
    Callback = function(v) SoundLeft = v end
})

SoundGroup:AddInput("SoundGeneralInput", {
    Default = SoundGeneral,
    Numeric = false,
    Finished = true,
    Text = "General Sound ID",
    Callback = function(v) SoundGeneral = v end
})

SoundGroup:AddSlider("SoundVolumeSlider", {
    Text = "Sound Volume",
    Default = 0.5, Min = 0, Max = 2, Rounding = 2,
    Callback = function(v) SoundVolume = v end
})

SoundGroup:AddButton({
    Text = "Test Sound",
    Func = function() PlaySound(SoundGeneral, SoundVolume) end
})

local TelemetryGroup = SettingsTab:AddRightGroupbox("Telemetry & Stats")

TelemetryGroup:AddToggle("TelemetryToggle", {
    Text = "Enable Telemetry Logging",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(v) TelemetryEnabled = v end
})

TelemetryGroup:AddButton({
    Text = "Print Telemetry to Console (F9)",
    Func = function()
        local elapsed = os.time() - TelemetryData.SessionStart
        local mins = math.floor(elapsed / 60)
        print("═══ persistence.win TELEMETRY ═══")
        print("Session Duration: " .. mins .. " minutes")
        print("Toggles Used: " .. TelemetryData.TogglesUsed)
        print("Buttons Pressed: " .. TelemetryData.ButtonsPressed)
        print("TPs Performed: " .. TelemetryData.TPsPerformed)
        print("Active Connections: " .. #MasterConnections)
        print("ESP Objects: " .. (function() local c=0; for _ in pairs(ESPObjects) do c+=1 end; return c end)())
        print("NPC ESP Objects: " .. #NPCESPObjects)
        print("Death Logs: " .. #DeathLogs)
        print("Waypoints: " .. (function() local c=0; for _ in pairs(Waypoints) do c+=1 end; return c end)())
        print("═════════════════════════════════")
        Notify("Telemetry", "Stats printed to console (F9)")
    end
})

local ThemeGroup = SettingsTab:AddRightGroupbox("Theme & Config")

ThemeManager:SetLibrary(Library)
SaveManager:SetLibrary(Library)
SaveManager:IgnoreThemeSettings()
SaveManager:SetIgnoreIndexes({"MenuKeybind"})
ThemeManager:SetFolder("PersistenceWin")
SaveManager:SetFolder("PersistenceWin/configs")

SaveManager:BuildConfigSection(SettingsTab)
ThemeManager:ApplyToTab(SettingsTab)

-- ============================================================
-- INPUT CONNECTIONS (all registered)
-- ============================================================

RegisterConnection(UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if InfiniteJumpEnabled then
        local hum = GetHumanoid()
        if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end
    end
end))

RegisterConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if gpe then return end
    if ClickTPEnabled and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
            local root = GetRootPart()
            if root and Mouse.Hit then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(Mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                BumpTelemetry("TPsPerformed")
            end
        end
    end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then FloatMovingUp = true end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then FloatMovingDown = true end
end))

RegisterConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then FloatMovingUp = false end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then FloatMovingDown = false end
end))

-- ============================================================
-- PLAYER CONNECTIONS (all registered, keyed per player) — PATCH #16, #17
-- ============================================================

local function SetupPlayerConnections(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end

    -- PATCH #17: Clean old connections if player somehow re-triggers
    CleanupPlayerConnections(player)

    RegisterPlayerConnection(player, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.wait(1)
        if ESPEnabled then ESPModule:AttachESP(player) end
        -- Re-hook death logger if enabled
        if DeathLogEnabled and not DeathConnections[player] then
            DeathLogModule:Watch(player)
        end
        -- Re-hook low HP if enabled
        if LowHPEnabled and not LowHPConnections[player] then
            LowHPModule:Watch(player)
        end
    end))
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    SetupPlayerConnections(player)
end

RegisterConnection(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    SetupPlayerConnections(player)
    if ESPEnabled then
        task.wait(1)
        ESPModule:CreateESP(player)
    end
    if DeathLogEnabled then DeathLogModule:Watch(player) end
    if LowHPEnabled then LowHPModule:Watch(player) end
end))

RegisterConnection(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    ESPModule:RemoveESP(player)
    CleanupPlayerConnections(player)
    DeathLogModule:Unwatch(player)
    LowHPModule:Unwatch(player)

    -- PATCH #6: Auto-disable latch if target leaves
    if LatchEnabled and LatchTarget == player then
        LatchEnabled = false
        LatchTarget = nil
        local mr = GetRootPart()
        if mr and LatchOrigin then mr.CFrame = LatchOrigin end
        LatchOrigin = nil
        if Toggles and Toggles.LatchToggle then Toggles.LatchToggle:SetValue(false) end
        Notify("Latch", "Target left, latch disabled — returned to origin")
    end

    -- PATCH #7: Auto-disable spectate if target leaves
    if SpectateEnabled and SpectateTarget == player then
        SpectateModule:Disable()
        SpectateEnabled = false
        if Toggles and Toggles.SpectateToggle then Toggles.SpectateToggle:SetValue(false) end
        Notify("Spectate", "Target left, spectate disabled")
    end
end))

-- Local player respawn
RegisterConnection(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(1)
    if FlyEnabled then FlyModule:Enable() end
    if FloatEnabled then FloatModule:Enable() end
    if SpeedEnabled then
        local hum = GetHumanoid()
        if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = SpeedValue end
    end
    if GodModeEnabled then
        local hum = GetHumanoid()
        if hum then hum.MaxHealth = math.huge; hum.Health = math.huge end
    end
    if MaxSlopeEnabled then
        local hum = GetHumanoid()
        if hum then hum.MaxSlopeAngle = 360 end
    end
    if SpectateEnabled and SpectateTarget then
        SpectateModule:CreateBeam()
    end
end))

-- ============================================================
-- INITIALIZE AIMBOT
-- ============================================================
AimbotModule:CreateFOVCircle()

-- ============================================================
-- MAIN RENDER LOOP (single connection, registered)
-- ============================================================

local perfPrintTimer = 0

RegisterConnection(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    -- Speed
    if SpeedEnabled then
        local hum = GetHumanoid()
        if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = SpeedValue end
    end

    -- Custom Gravity
    if CustomGravityEnabled then
        Workspace.Gravity = CustomGravityValue
    end

    -- Instant Stop
    InstantStopUpdate()

    -- Noclip
    NoclipUpdate()

    -- Fly
    FlyModule:Update()

    -- Float Platform
    FloatModule:Update()

    -- ESP
    if ESPEnabled then ESPModule:UpdateESP() end

    -- NPC ESP
    if NPCESPEnabled then NPCESPModule:Update() end

    -- Aimbot
    AimbotModule:UpdateFOVCircle()
    if AimbotEnabled and UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then
        local target = AimbotModule:GetClosestPlayer()
        if target then AimbotModule:AimAt(target) end
    end

    -- Fullbright maintenance
    if FullbrightEnabled then
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(178, 178, 178)
        Lighting.Brightness = 2
        Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
    end

    -- PATCH #6: Latch follow with validity check
    if LatchEnabled and LatchTarget then
        if not LatchTarget.Parent then
            -- Player left
            LatchEnabled = false
            local mr = GetRootPart()
            if mr and LatchOrigin then mr.CFrame = LatchOrigin end
            LatchTarget = nil; LatchOrigin = nil
            if Toggles and Toggles.LatchToggle then Toggles.LatchToggle:SetValue(false) end
        else
            local myRoot = GetRootPart()
            local tChar = LatchTarget.Character
            if tChar and myRoot then
                local tRoot = tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if tRoot then
                    myRoot.CFrame = tRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- PATCH #7: Spectate validation
    SpectateModule:Validate()

    -- PATCH #19: Performance tracker using dt instead of RenderStepped:Wait()
    if PerfTrackerEnabled then
        FPSAccumulator += dt
        FPSFrameCount += 1

        perfPrintTimer += dt
        if perfPrintTimer >= 5 then
            perfPrintTimer = 0
            local avgFPS = FPSFrameCount > 0 and math.floor(FPSFrameCount / FPSAccumulator) or 0
            FPSAccumulator = 0
            FPSFrameCount = 0

            local ping = 0
            pcall(function()
                ping = math.floor(Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue())
            end)
            local mem = 0
            pcall(function()
                mem = math.floor(Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb())
            end)
            warn(string.format("[persistence.win Perf] FPS: %d | Ping: %dms | Memory: %dMB", avgFPS, ping, mem))
        end
    end
end))

-- ============================================================
-- SET MENU TOGGLE KEYBIND
-- ============================================================
Library.ToggleKeybind = Options.MenuKeybind

-- ============================================================
-- STARTUP
-- ============================================================
Notify("persistence.win", "Loaded! RightControl to toggle menu.", 5)
PlaySound(SoundGeneral, SoundVolume)

print("[persistence.win] All modules loaded successfully!")
print("[persistence.win] join to suggest: discord.gg/MU4W3uPf9p")
print("[persistence.win] credits to ai")
print("Tabs: Movement | Combat | Players | Visuals | Teleport | Utilities | Settings")
