scripts.script:
--!nocheck
local __dcm_boot = {
	hostEnv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G or {},
}

__dcm_boot.getLoader = function()
	local hostLoader = type(__dcm_boot.hostEnv) == "table" and rawget(__dcm_boot.hostEnv, "loadstring") or nil
	if type(hostLoader) == "function" then
		return hostLoader
	end
	if type(loadstring) == "function" then
		return loadstring
	end
	return nil
end
local __dcm_isDelta = false
if type(identifyexecutor) == "function" then
	local ok, name = pcall(identifyexecutor)
	__dcm_isDelta = ok and type(name) == "string" and name:lower() == "delta"
end
if not __dcm_isDelta then
	pcall(function()
		local loader = __dcm_boot.getLoader()
		if type(loader) ~= "function" then
			return
		end
		local src = game:HttpGet("https://gitlab.com/ltseverydayyou/Nameless-Admin/-/raw/main/NamelessAdminNotifications.lua")
		local chunk = loader(src, "@NamelessAdminNotifications.lua")
		if type(chunk) ~= "function" then
			return
		end
		local mod = chunk()
		if type(mod) == "table" and type(mod.Notify) == "function" then
			mod.Notify({
				Title = "Delta Only",
				Description = "This script ONLY supports Delta's UI.\nTo that ScriptBlox reviewer: testing a Delta customizer on another executor and whining 'doesn't work' is a reading problem, not a script problem.",
				Duration = 9,
			})
		end
	end)
	return
end

__dcm_boot.hostGetfenv = type(__dcm_boot.hostEnv.getfenv) == "function" and __dcm_boot.hostEnv.getfenv or getfenv
__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv = type(__dcm_boot.hostEnv.setfenv) == "function" and __dcm_boot.hostEnv.setfenv or setfenv
__dcm_boot.debug = rawget(__dcm_boot.hostEnv, "debug") or debug
__dcm_boot.getPrivateRegistry = function()
	local registry
	if type(getreg) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			registry = getreg()
		end)
	end
	if type(registry) ~= "table" and type(__dcm_boot.debug) == "table" and type(__dcm_boot.debug.getregistry) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			registry = __dcm_boot.debug.getregistry()
		end)
	end
	if type(registry) ~= "table" then
		registry = {}
	end
	return registry
end
__dcm_boot.ensureTable = function(host, key)
	local value = type(host) == "table" and rawget(host, key) or nil
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		value = {}
		if type(host) == "table" then
			pcall(rawset, host, key, value)
			if rawget(host, key) ~= value then
				host[key] = value
			end
		end
	end
	return value
end
__dcm_boot.clearHostKey = function(host, key)
	if type(host) == "table" then
		pcall(rawset, host, key, nil)
		pcall(function()
			host[key] = nil
		end)
	end
end
__dcm_boot.clearLegacyGlobals = function(host)
	local keys = {
		"__DeltaCustomizationModuleLoaded",
		"__DeltaVisualPatchLoaded",
		"__DeltaThemeMenuPatchLoaded",
		"__DeltaHubMusicPatch",
		"DeltaIcon",
	}
	for i = 1, #keys do
		__dcm_boot.clearHostKey(host, keys[i])
	end
	local sh = type(host) == "table" and rawget(host, "shared") or nil
	if type(sh) == "table" and sh ~= host then
		for i = 1, #keys do
			__dcm_boot.clearHostKey(sh, keys[i])
		end
	end
end
__dcm_boot.privateRegistry = __dcm_boot.getPrivateRegistry()
__dcm_boot.privateRoot = __dcm_boot.ensureTable(__dcm_boot.privateRegistry, "__nameless_admin_private")
local __dcm_env = __dcm_boot.ensureTable(__dcm_boot.privateRoot, "delta_customization")
local __dcm_shared = __dcm_boot.ensureTable(__dcm_env, "shared")
__dcm_boot.runtimeEnv = __dcm_boot.ensureTable(__dcm_env, "runtime")

__dcm_boot.runtimeEnv.shared = __dcm_shared
__dcm_boot.runtimeEnv._G = __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv
__dcm_boot.runtimeEnv.getgenv = function()
	return __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv
end
__dcm_boot.runtimeEnv.getfenv = function(target)
	if target == nil or target == 0 then
		return __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv
	end
	if type(__dcm_boot.hostGetfenv) == "function" then
		return __dcm_boot.hostGetfenv(target)
	end
	return __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv
end

setmetatable(__dcm_boot.runtimeEnv, {
	__index = function(_, key)
		if key == "_G" then
			return __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv
		elseif key == "shared" then
			return __dcm_shared
		elseif key == "getgenv" then
			return __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv.getgenv
		elseif key == "getfenv" then
			return __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv.getfenv
		end
		return __dcm_boot.hostEnv[key]
	end,
})

if type(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv) == "function" then
	pcall(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv, 1, __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv)
end

local __lt = (function()
	local cached = rawget(__dcm_boot.privateRoot, "serviceResolver")
	if type(cached) == "table" then
		return cached
	end
	local loader = __dcm_boot.getLoader()
	if type(loader) ~= "function" then
		error("Service resolver loader unavailable")
	end
	local okSrc, src = pcall(function()
		return game:HttpGet("https://gitlab.com/ltseverydayyou/ltseverydayyou.gitlab.io/-/raw/main/ServiceResolver.luau")
	end)
	if not (okSrc and type(src) == "string" and src ~= "") then
		error("Service resolver HTTP failed: " .. tostring(typeof and typeof(src) or type(src)))
	end
	local resolver = loader(src, "@ServiceResolver.luau")
	if type(resolver) ~= "function" then
		error("Service resolver failed to compile")
	end
	if type(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv) == "function" then
		pcall(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv, resolver, __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv)
	end
	local loaded = resolver()
	if type(loaded) ~= "table" then
		error("Service resolver failed to load")
	end
	__dcm_boot.privateRoot.serviceResolver = loaded
	return loaded
end)()
local __NAUIProtector = (function()
	local cacheHost = __dcm_env;
	if cacheHost then
		local cached = rawget(cacheHost, "__lt_ui_protector");
		if type(cached) == "table" then
			return cached;
		end;
	end;
	local loader = __dcm_boot.getLoader();
	if type(loader) ~= "function" then
		return nil;
	end;
	local okSource, source = pcall(function()
		return game:HttpGet("https://gitlab.com/ltseverydayyou/ltseverydayyou.gitlab.io/-/raw/main/UIprotector.luau");
	end);
	if not okSource or type(source) ~= "string" or source == "" then
		return nil;
	end;
	local chunk = loader(source, "@UIprotector.luau");
	if type(chunk) ~= "function" then
		return nil;
	end;
	if type(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv) == "function" then
		pcall(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv, chunk, __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv);
	end;
	local okLoaded, loaded = pcall(chunk);
	if okLoaded and type(loaded) == "table" then
		if cacheHost then
			cacheHost.__lt_ui_protector = loaded;
		end;
		return loaded;
	end;
	return nil;
end)();
local __NAOriginalGetHui = gethui;
local gethui = function()
	if __NAUIProtector and type(__NAUIProtector.huiGrabber) == "function" then
		local ok, ui = pcall(__NAUIProtector.huiGrabber);
		if ok and typeof(ui) == "Instance" then
			return ui;
		end;
	end;
	if type(__NAOriginalGetHui) == "function" then
		local ok, ui = pcall(__NAOriginalGetHui);
		if ok then
			return ui;
		end;
	end;
	return nil;
end;
local function __NAProtectUI(gui, options)
	if __NAUIProtector and type(__NAUIProtector.protectUI) == "function" then
		local ok, protected = pcall(__NAUIProtector.protectUI, gui, options);
		if ok and protected then
			return protected;
		end;
	end;
	return nil;
end;

local function dcmAlreadyLoaded()
	if __dcm_env and __dcm_env.__DeltaCustomizationModuleLoaded then
		return true
	end
	if __dcm_shared and __dcm_shared.__DeltaCustomizationModuleLoaded then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

local __dcm_previousMasterRuntime = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaCustomizationMasterRuntime")
if type(__dcm_previousMasterRuntime) == "table" and type(__dcm_previousMasterRuntime.stop) == "function" then
	pcall(__dcm_previousMasterRuntime.stop)
else
	local __dcm_previousRuntime = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaCustomizationV2Runtime")
	if type(__dcm_previousRuntime) == "table" and type(__dcm_previousRuntime.stop) == "function" then
		pcall(__dcm_previousRuntime.stop)
	end
end
__dcm_env.__DeltaCustomizationModuleLoaded = nil
__dcm_shared.__DeltaCustomizationModuleLoaded = nil
__dcm_env.__DeltaVisualPatchLoaded = nil
__dcm_env.__DeltaThemeMenuPatchLoaded = nil

local __dcm_flag = {
	version = "2.5.8",
	loadedAt = tick(),
}
__dcm_env.__DeltaCustomizationModuleLoaded = __dcm_flag
__dcm_shared.__DeltaCustomizationModuleLoaded = __dcm_flag
local httpTxt
local UIS
local root
local settingsPath
local notify
local _naConns
local NAlib
local writeJsonFile

do
local deltaEnv = __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv
local _ref = cloneref and type(cloneref) == "function" and cloneref or function(v)
	return v
end
local SRV = setmetatable({}, {
	__index = function(self, n)
		local ok, s = pcall(function()
			return __lt.cs(n, _ref)
		end)
		if ok and s then
			rawset(self, n, s)
			return s
		end
	end,
})
local function Svc(n)
	return SRV[n]
end

httpTxt = function(u, hdr)
	if type(u) ~= "string" or u == "" then
		return nil, "bad url"
	end
	local rq = (syn and syn.request) or request or http_request or (http and http.request)
	if type(rq) == "function" then
		local h = {
			["User-Agent"] = "Roblox/Http/1.1",
			["Accept"] = "*/*",
		}
		if type(hdr) == "table" then
			for k, v in hdr do
				h[k] = v
			end
		end
		local ok, res = pcall(rq, {
			Url = u,
			Method = "GET",

local function MouseButtonFix(button, clickCallback)
	if not button or type(clickCallback) ~= "function" then
		return { Disconnect = function() end }
	end
	local clickTimeThreshold = 0.45
	local moveThreshold = 10
	local mouseDownTime = 0
	local isPointerDown = false
	local startPosition = nil
	local maxMoveDistance = 0
	local connections = {}
	local function getSignal(obj, signalName)
		local ok, signal = pcall(function()
			return obj[signalName]
		end)
		if ok and signal then
			return signal
		end
		return nil
	end
	local function connectSignal(signal, fn)
		if not signal then
			return false
		end
		local ok, conn = pcall(function()
			return signal:Connect(fn)
		end)
		if ok and conn then
			connections[#connections + 1] = conn
			return true
		end
		return false
	end
	local function isPressInput(inputType)
		return inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	end
	local function resetState()
		mouseDownTime = 0
		isPointerDown = false
		startPosition = nil
		maxMoveDistance = 0
	end
	local function beginPointer(input)
		isPointerDown = true
		mouseDownTime = tick()
		maxMoveDistance = 0
		local pos = input and input.Position
		startPosition = pos and Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) or nil
	end
	local function endPointer()
		if not isPointerDown or mouseDownTime == 0 then
			resetState()
			return
		end
		local holdDuration = tick() - mouseDownTime
		local isClick = holdDuration < clickTimeThreshold and maxMoveDistance <= moveThreshold
		resetState()
		if isClick then
			clickCallback()
		end
	end
	local boundPress = false
	local isGuiButton = type(button.IsA) == "function" and button:IsA("GuiButton")
	if isGuiButton then
		local downSignal = getSignal(button, "MouseButton1Down")
		local upSignal = getSignal(button, "MouseButton1Up")
		local downBound = connectSignal(downSignal, function()
			beginPointer(nil)
		end)
		local upBound = connectSignal(upSignal, function()
			endPointer()
		end)
		boundPress = downBound and upBound
	end
	if not boundPress then
		local beganSignal = getSignal(button, "InputBegan")
		local endedSignal = getSignal(button, "InputEnded")
		local beganBound = connectSignal(beganSignal, function(input)
			if input and isPressInput(input.UserInputType) then
				beginPointer(input)
			end
		end)
		local endedBound = connectSignal(endedSignal, function(input)
			if input and isPressInput(input.UserInputType) then
				endPointer()
			end
		end)
		boundPress = beganBound and endedBound
	end
	local changedSignal = getSignal(button, "InputChanged")
	connectSignal(changedSignal, function(input)
		if not isPointerDown then
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			return
		end
		local pos = input.Position
		if not pos then
			return
		end
		if not startPosition then
			startPosition = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
			return
		end
		local currentPos = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
		local delta = (currentPos - startPosition).Magnitude
		if delta > maxMoveDistance then
			maxMoveDistance = delta
		end
	end)
	if not boundPress then
		return { Disconnect = function() end }
	end
	return {
		Disconnect = function()
			for _, conn in connections do
				if conn and conn.Disconnect then
					conn:Disconnect()
				end
			end
		end,
	}
end
local function hideOriginalDeltaIcon()
	if managedIcon.deltaGui then
		__dcm_setTracked(managedIcon.deltaGui, "Enabled", false)
	end
	if managedIcon.deltaBtn then
		__dcm_setTracked(managedIcon.deltaBtn, "Visible", false)
		__dcm_setTracked(managedIcon.deltaBtn, "Active", false)
		__dcm_setTracked(managedIcon.deltaBtn, "ImageTransparency", 1)
		__dcm_setTracked(managedIcon.deltaBtn, "BackgroundTransparency", 1)
	end
	if managedIcon.deltaStroke then
		__dcm_setTracked(managedIcon.deltaStroke, "Enabled", false)
	end
end
local function refreshIconRefs()
	local prevIconGui = iconGui
	local prevIconBtn = iconBtn
	local ig, ib = getIconGui()
	local deltaChanged = ig ~= managedIcon.deltaGui or ib ~= managedIcon.deltaBtn
	managedIcon.deltaGui = ig
	managedIcon.deltaBtn = ib
	managedIcon.deltaStroke = managedIcon.deltaBtn
		and (
			managedIcon.deltaBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
			or managedIcon.deltaBtn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke", true)
		)
	managedIcon.deltaCorner = managedIcon.deltaBtn
		and (
			managedIcon.deltaBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
			or managedIcon.deltaBtn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UICorner", true)
		)
	if managedIcon.deltaGui or managedIcon.deltaBtn then
		hideOriginalDeltaIcon()
		NAlib.disconnect("DeltaIcon_OriginalHideGui")
		if managedIcon.deltaGui then
			NAlib.connect(
				"DeltaIcon_OriginalHideGui",
				managedIcon.deltaGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
					if managedIcon.deltaGui.Enabled then
						hideOriginalDeltaIcon()
					end
				end)
			)
		end
		NAlib.disconnect("DeltaIcon_OriginalHideBtn")
		if managedIcon.deltaBtn then
			NAlib.connect(
				"DeltaIcon_OriginalHideBtn",
				managedIcon.deltaBtn:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
					if managedIcon.deltaBtn.Visible then
						hideOriginalDeltaIcon()
					end
				end)
			)
		end
	end
	if ensureManagedIcon then
		ensureManagedIcon()
	end
	if managedIcon.customBtn and managedIcon.customBtn.Parent then
		iconGui = managedIcon.customGui
		iconBtn = managedIcon.customBtn
		iconStroke = managedIcon.customStroke
		iconCorner = managedIcon.customCorner
	else
		iconGui = managedIcon.deltaGui
		iconBtn = managedIcon.deltaBtn
		iconStroke = managedIcon.deltaStroke
		iconCorner = managedIcon.deltaCorner
	end
	local changed = deltaChanged or iconGui ~= prevIconGui or iconBtn ~= prevIconBtn
	if iconBtn then
		if changed or not iconBaseSize then
			iconBaseSize = iconBtn.Size
		end
		if iconStroke and not iconColorUseCustom and (changed or not iconBaseColor) then
			iconBaseColor = iconStroke.Color
		end
		if iconCorner and (changed or not iconBaseCorner) then
			iconBaseCorner = iconCorner.CornerRadius
		end
		if changed and applyIconStrokeState then
			task.defer(applyIconStrokeState)
		end
		if changed and applyIconShapeChoice then
			task.defer(applyIconShapeChoice)
		end
		if changed and applySavedManagedIconPosition then
			task.defer(applySavedManagedIconPosition)
		end
		if changed and bindManagedIconPositionSaver then
			task.defer(bindManagedIconPositionSaver)
		end
		if changed and bindManagedIconToggle then
			task.defer(bindManagedIconToggle)
		end
	end
	return changed
end
local function fsOk()
	return type(isfile) == "function" and type(writefile) == "function"
end
local function gaOk()
	return type(getcustomasset) == "function"
end
local function iconFsOk()
	return fsOk() and gaOk()
end
local function trim(s)
	if type(s) ~= "string" then
		return ""
	end
	return s:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
end
local function sName(name)
	if type(name) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local t = trim(name)
	t = t:gsub("[^%w%._%-]", "_")
	t = t:gsub("_+", "_")
	t = t:gsub("^_+", "")
	t = t:gsub("_+$", "")
	if t == "" then
		return nil
	end
	return t
end
local function getName(path)
	if type(path) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local n = path:gsub("\\", "/")
	return n:match("([^/]+)$")
end
local function fileFromUrl(u)
	if type(u) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	return u:match("/([^/%?]+)$")
end
local function iconPreUrl(u)
	if type(u) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local t = trim(u)
	if t == "" then
		return nil
	end
	t = t:gsub(" ", "%%20")
	local q = t:find("%?")
	local base = q and t:sub(1, q - 1) or t
	return t, base
end
local function iconNormUrl(u)
	local t, base = iconPreUrl(u)
	if not t then
		return nil
	end
	local owner, repo, kind, rest = base:match("^https?://github.com/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/(.+)$")
	if owner and repo and kind and rest then
		local s = rest
		if s:sub(1, 11) == "refs/heads/" then
			s = s:sub(12)
		elseif s:sub(1, 10) == "refs/tags/" then
			s = s:sub(11)
		end
		local branch, path = s:match("^([^/]+)/(.+)$")
		if branch and path and (kind == "blob" or kind == "raw") then
			branch = branch:gsub("%%2[Ff]", "/")
			path = path:gsub("%%2[Ff]", "/")
			return string.format("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%s/%s/%s/%s", owner, repo, branch, path)
		end
	end
	local rawDir = base:match("^https?://raw%.githubusercontent%.com/.+")
	if rawDir then
		return t
	end
	return t
end
local function ensureDir(path)
	if not fsOk() then
		return false
	end
	if type(isfolder) == "function" then
		local ok, ex = pcall(isfolder, path)
		if ok and ex then
			return true
		end
		if type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end
		local okMk = pcall(makefolder, path)
		return okMk == true
	end
	return true
end
local function ensureParentDir(path)
	if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then
		return false
	end
	local dir = path:gsub("\\", "/"):match("^(.*)/[^/]+$")
	if not dir or dir == "" then
		return true
	end
	return ensureDir(dir)
end
writeJsonFile = function(path, payload)
	if not (HS and fsOk()) then
		return false
	end
	if not ensureParentDir(path) then
		return false
	end
	local okEnc, enc = pcall(function()
		return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONEncode", payload)
	end)
	if not (okEnc and type(enc) == "string") then
		return false
	end
	local okW = pcall(writefile, path, enc)
	if okW then
		return true
	end
	return pcall(writefile, path, enc)
end
local baseDir = "DeltaCustom"
local iconDir = baseDir .. "/DeltaIcons"
local cfgPath = baseDir .. "/delta_icon.json"
local dIcons = {
	entries = {},
	index = 0,
	enabled = false,
	localPath = "",
	assetId = "",
	defaultImage = "",
	pendingInput = "",
}
local function ensureIconDir()
	if not ensureDir(baseDir) then
		return false
	end
	return ensureDir(iconDir)
end
local function loadIconCfg()
	if not fsOk() or not HS then
		return
	end
	if type(isfolder) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function" then
		local okB, exB = pcall(isfolder, baseDir)
		if not (okB and exB) then
			pcall(makefolder, baseDir)
		end
	end
	if type(isfile) == "function" and type(writefile) == "function" then
		if not isfile(cfgPath) then
			pcall(
				writefile,
				cfgPath,
				__lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONEncode", {
					enabled = false,
					assetId = "",
					localPath = "",
					index = 0,
				})
			)
		end
	end
	if type(isfile) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	if not isfile(cfgPath) then
		return
	end
	local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, cfgPath)
	if not (ok and type(raw) == "string") then
		return
	end
	local okD, dec = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, raw)
	if not (okD and type(dec) == "table") then
		return
	end
	if type(dec.enabled) == "boolean" then
		dIcons.enabled = dec.enabled
	end
	if type(dec.assetId) == "string" then
		dIcons.assetId = dec.assetId
	end
	if type(dec.localPath) == "string" then
		dIcons.localPath = dec.localPath
	end
	if type(dec.index) == "number" then
		dIcons.index = dec.index
	end
end
local function saveIconCfg()
	if not fsOk() or not HS then
		return
	end
	local payload = {
		enabled = dIcons.enabled and true or false,
		assetId = type(dIcons.assetId) == "string" and dIcons.assetId or "",
		localPath = type(dIcons.localPath) == "string" and dIcons.localPath or "",
		index = tonumber(dIcons.index) or 0,
	}
	writeJsonFile(cfgPath, payload)
end
local function scanIcons()
	dIcons.entries = {}
	dIcons.index = 0
	if not (fsOk() and type(listfiles) == "function") then
		return
	end
	if not ensureIconDir() then
		return
	end
	local ok, items = pcall(listfiles, iconDir)
	if not (ok and type(items) == "table") then
		return
	end
	local list = {}
	for _, full in items do
		local n = getName(full)
		if n then
			list[#list + 1] = { file = n }
		end
	end
	dIcons.entries = list
	if type(dIcons.localPath) == "string" and dIcons.localPath ~= "" then
		local cur = getName(dIcons.localPath)
		if cur then
			for i, e in list do
				if e.file == cur then
					dIcons.index = i
					if updateIconStatusUI then
						updateIconStatusUI()
					end
					return
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if #list > 0 then
		dIcons.index = 1
	end
	if updateIconStatusUI then
		updateIconStatusUI()
	end
end
local function formatIconStatus()
	local list = dIcons.entries
	local n = #list
	if n == 0 then
		return "No custom icons installed"
	end
	if n == 1 then
		return "1 custom icon installed"
	end
	return tostring(n) .. " custom icons installed"
end
local function resolveIconAsset(full)
	if not gaOk() or type(full) ~= "string" or full == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local tried = {}
	local function tryPath(path)
		if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" or tried[path] then
			return nil
		end
		tried[path] = true
		local okA, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
		if okA and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
			return asset
		end
		return nil
	end
	local asset = tryPath(full)
	if asset then
		return asset
	end
	local slash = full:gsub("\\", "/")
	if slash ~= full then
		asset = tryPath(slash)
		if asset then
			return asset
		end
	end
	local back = full:gsub("/", "\\")
	if back ~= full then
		asset = tryPath(back)
		if asset then
			return asset
		end
	end
	local name = getName(full)
	if name then
		asset = tryPath(iconDir .. "/" .. name) or tryPath(iconDir .. "\\" .. name) or tryPath(name)
		if asset then
			return asset
		end
	end
	return nil
end
local function iconHttpGetBinary(url, headers)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local function tryRequest(hdr)
		if type(rq) ~= "function" then
			return nil
		end
		local h = {}
		if type(hdr) == "table" then
			for k, v in hdr do
				h[k] = v
			end
		end
		h["User-Agent"] = h["User-Agent"] or "Roblox/Http/1.1"
		h["Accept"] = h["Accept"] or "*/*"
		local ok, res = pcall(rq, {
			Url = url,
			Method = "GET",
			Headers = h,
		})
		if ok and res then
			local code = res.StatusCode or res.Status or res.status_code or 0
			local body = res.Body or res.body
			if (code == 0 or (code >= 200 and code < 300)) and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then
				return body
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local data = tryRequest(headers)
	if type(data) == "string" and data ~= "" then
		return data
	end
	local ok2, body2 = pcall(function()
		return game:HttpGet(url)
	end)
	if ok2 and type(body2) == "string" and body2 ~= "" then
		return body2
	end
	return tryRequest(nil)
end
local function iconSaveFromUrl(url)
	if not iconFsOk() then
		return false, "Custom icons require file support and getcustomasset."
	end
	if not ensureIconDir() then
		return false, "Unable to prepare DeltaIcons folder."
	end
	local norm = iconNormUrl(url)
	if not norm then
		return false, "Enter a valid image URL or asset id."
	end
	local data = iconHttpGetBinary(norm)
	if not (type(data) == "string" and data ~= "") then
		return false, "Unable to download icon image."
	end
	local remote = fileFromUrl(norm) or "DeltaIcon.png"
	local safe = sName(remote) or "icon_" .. tostring(os.time()) .. ".png"
	local full = iconDir .. "/" .. safe
	local okW, errW = pcall(writefile, full, data)
	if not okW then
		return false, errW or "Unable to save icon image."
	end
	local asset = resolveIconAsset(full)
	if not asset then
		return false, "Unable to load icon image."
	end
	dIcons.localPath = full
	local list = dIcons.entries
	local idx
	for i, e in list do
		if e.file == safe then
			idx = i
			break
		end
	end
	if not idx then
		list[#list + 1] = { file = safe }
		idx = #list
	end
	dIcons.entries = list
	dIcons.index = idx
	if updateIconStatusUI then
		updateIconStatusUI()
	end
	return true, asset
end
local function applyIcon()
	refreshIconRefs()
	if not iconBtn or (not iconBtn:IsA("ImageButton")) then
		return false
	end
	local img
	if dIcons.enabled and type(dIcons.assetId) == "string" and dIcons.assetId ~= "" then
		img = dIcons.assetId
	elseif type(dIcons.defaultImage) == "string" and dIcons.defaultImage ~= "" then
		img = dIcons.defaultImage
	end
	iconApplyBusy = true
	if img and img ~= "" then
		iconBtn.Image = img
		iconApplyBusy = false
		return true
	else
		iconBtn.Image = ""
	end
	iconApplyBusy = false
	return false
end
local function setIconEnabled(flag)
	if not iconFsOk() then
		return false, "Custom icon requires file support and getcustomasset."
	end
	flag = flag and true or false
	if flag and (not dIcons.assetId or dIcons.assetId == "") then
		return false, "Add an asset id or image URL before enabling."
	end
	dIcons.enabled = flag
	applyIcon()
	saveIconCfg()
	return true
end
local function setIconAsset(input, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	if not iconFsOk() then
		return false, "Custom icon requires file support and getcustomasset."
	end
	local raw = type(input) == "string" and input or tostring(input)
	if type(raw) ~= "string" then
		return false, "Enter a valid asset id or image URL."
	end
	raw = trim(raw)
	if raw == "" then
		return false, "Enter a valid asset id or image URL."
	end
	local digits = raw:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$") or raw:match("id=(%d+)") or raw:match("^(%d+)$")
	local newAsset
	dIcons.localPath = ""
	if digits then
		newAsset = "rbxassetid://" .. digits
	else
		local okIcon, res = iconSaveFromUrl(raw)
		if not okIcon then
			return false, res or "Unable to save custom icon."
		end
		newAsset = res
		scanIcons()
	end
	dIcons.assetId = newAsset
	if opts.autoEnable ~= false then
		dIcons.enabled = true
	end
	applyIcon()
	saveIconCfg()
	if digits then
		return true, digits
	end
	return true, raw
end
local function cycleIcon(delta)
	local list = dIcons.entries
	if #list == 0 then
		return
	end
	delta = delta or 1
	local idx = dIcons.index or 1
	if idx < 1 or idx > #list then
		idx = 1
	end
	idx = (idx - 1 + delta) % #list + 1
	local e = list[idx]
	if not e or not e.file then
		return
	end
	local full = iconDir .. "/" .. e.file
	if fsOk() and type(isfile) == "function" then
		local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
		if not (okEx and ex) then
			scanIcons()
			return
		end
	end
	local asset = resolveIconAsset(full)
	if not asset then
		return
	end
	dIcons.localPath = full
	dIcons.assetId = asset
	dIcons.index = idx
	dIcons.enabled = true
	applyIcon()
	saveIconCfg()
	if updateIconStatusUI then
		updateIconStatusUI()
	end
end
local function delIconFile(name)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then
		return
	end
	if not (fsOk() and type(delfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function") then
		return
	end
	local full = iconDir .. "/" .. name
	local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
	if okEx and ex then
		pcall(delfile, full)
	end
end
local function clearIfCurrent(name)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then
		return
	end
	local full = iconDir .. "/" .. name
	if dIcons.localPath == full then
		dIcons.localPath = ""
		dIcons.assetId = ""
		dIcons.index = 0
		dIcons.enabled = false
		applyIcon()
		saveIconCfg()
	end
end
local function removeIconEntry(entry)
	if not (entry and entry.file) then
		return
	end
	delIconFile(entry.file)
	clearIfCurrent(entry.file)
	scanIcons()
end
local function removeAllIcons()
	local list = dIcons.entries or {}
	for _, e in list do
		if e and e.file then
			delIconFile(e.file)
		end
	end
	dIcons.entries = {}
	dIcons.index = 0
	dIcons.localPath = ""
	dIcons.assetId = ""
	dIcons.enabled = false
	applyIcon()
	saveIconCfg()
	scanIcons()
end
ensureManagedIcon = function()
	if
		mainGui
		and managedIcon.customBtn
		and managedIcon.customBtn.Parent == mainGui
	then
		managedIcon.customGui = mainGui
		managedIcon.customStroke = managedIcon.customBtn
			and (
				managedIcon.customBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
				or managedIcon.customBtn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke", true)
			)
		managedIcon.customCorner = managedIcon.customBtn
			and (
				managedIcon.customBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
				or managedIcon.customBtn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UICorner", true)
			)
		return true
	end
	if not (mainGui and managedIcon.deltaGui and managedIcon.deltaBtn) then
		return false
	end
	hideOriginalDeltaIcon()
	local btn = managedIcon.deltaBtn:Clone()
	btn.Name = "LTIcon"
	btn.Visible = true
	btn.Active = true
	btn.ImageTransparency = managedIcon.deltaBtn.ImageTransparency
	btn.BackgroundTransparency = managedIcon.deltaBtn.BackgroundTransparency
	btn.Parent = mainGui

			return
		end

		fr.Parent = settingsHolder

			tl.Text = titleText
		end
		if dl then
			dl.Text = descText
		end

		if ob then
			ob:Destroy()
		end

		local vb = mkBox(dock)
		local sl, bar, fill, kb = mkSl(dock, 150)
		local sv = settingsConfig[key]
		if type(sv) == "table" and type(sv.value) == "number" then
			numValue.Value = math.clamp(sv.value, minV, maxV)
		end
		local function save(v)
			if opts.persist == false then
				return
			end
			if not (HS and type(writefile) == "function") then
				return
			end
			settingsConfig[key] = { value = v }
			writeJsonFile(settingsPath, settingsConfig)
		end
		local function setVis(v)
			if opts.integer then
				v = math.floor((tonumber(v) or minV) + 0.5)
			end
			v = math.clamp(v, minV, maxV)
			local denom = maxV - minV
			local a = denom ~= 0 and ((v - minV) / denom) or 0
			fill.Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0)
			kb.Position = UDim2.new(a, 0, 0.5, 0)
			vb.Text = opts.integer and tostring(v) or string.format("%.2f", v)
		end
		local function commit(v)
			if opts.integer then
				v = math.floor((tonumber(v) or minV) + 0.5)
			end
			v = math.clamp(v, minV, maxV)
			numValue.Value = v
			setVis(v)
			save(v)
			if type(opts.apply) == "function" then
				pcall(opts.apply, v)
			end
		end
		setVis(numValue.Value)
		local drag = false
		local pendingValue = numValue.Value
		local function fromIn(input)
			local rel = 0
			pcall(function()
				rel = (input.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X
			end)
			rel = math.clamp(rel, 0, 1)
			local nextV = minV + (maxV - minV) * rel
			if opts.integer then
				nextV = math.floor(nextV + 0.5)
			end
			if opts.applyOnRelease then
				pendingValue = nextV
				setVis(nextV)
			else
				commit(nextV)
			end
		end
		bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if
				input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			then
				drag = true
				fromIn(input)
			end
		end)
		NAlib.disconnect(slId)
		NAlib.connect(
			slId,
			UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
				if not drag then
					return
				end
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					fromIn(input)
				end
			end)
		)
		NAlib.connect(
			slId,
			UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					if drag and opts.applyOnRelease then
						commit(pendingValue)
					end
					drag = false
				end
			end)
		)
		fr.Destroying:Connect(function()
			NAlib.disconnect(slId)
		end)
		vb.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local v = tonumber(vb.Text or "")
			if v then
				commit(v)
			else
				setVis(numValue.Value)
			end
		end)

			local w = math.clamp(math.floor(fr.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.46), 240, 380)
			dock.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 18)
			local sw = math.clamp(w - 78, 140, 280)
			sl.Size = UDim2.new(0, sw, 0, 18)
		end
		updDock()
		fr:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			task.defer(updDock)
		end)
	end

	function applySidebarGestureState()
		if not sidebar then
			sidebarGestureEnabled = false
			saveSidebarGesture()
			return
		end
		ensureSidebarGestureFrame()
		if not sidebarGestureFrame then
			sidebarGestureEnabled = false
			saveSidebarGesture()
			return
		end
		if toggleUIBtn and toggleUIBtn:IsA("ImageButton") then
			pcall(function()
				toggleUIBtn.Visible = not sidebarGestureEnabled
			end)
		end
		NAlib.disconnect("SidebarGesture")
		sidebarGestureFrame.Active = false
		sidebarGestureFrame.Visible = false
		if not sidebarGestureEnabled then
			setIconForcedHidden(false)
			saveSidebarGesture()
			return
		end
		setIconForcedHidden(true)
		sidebarGestureFrame.Active = true
		sidebarGestureFrame.Visible = true
		applyGestureVisual()
		applyGestureSize()
		local id = "SidebarGesture"
		local function recalcGesturePosition()
			if not (mainGui and sidebar and sidebarGestureFrame) then
				return
			end
			local sgSize = mainGui.AbsoluteSize
			if sgSize.X <= 0 or sgSize.Y <= 0 then
				return
			end
			local sbPos = sidebar.AbsolutePosition
			local sbSize = sidebar.AbsoluteSize
			local px = sbPos.X - 8
			sidebarGestureFrame.Position = UDim2.new(px / sgSize.X, 0, 0.5, 0)
		end
		local function getSidebarAlpha()
			if not sidebar then
				return 0
			end
			local sx = sidebar.Position.X.Scale
			local denom = sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale - sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale
			if denom == 0 then
				return 0
			end
			return math.clamp((sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale - sx) / denom, 0, 1)
		end
		recalcGesturePosition()
		NAlib.connect(id, (sidebar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position")):Connect(recalcGesturePosition))
		if sidebar.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
			NAlib.connect(id, (sidebar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size")):Connect(recalcGesturePosition))
		end
		if mainGui and mainGui.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
			NAlib.connect(id, (mainGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize")):Connect(recalcGesturePosition))
		end
		local function updateSidebarFromInput(input)
			if not sidebar or not mainGui then
				return
			end
			local dx = input.Position.X - sidebarDragStartX
			local guiSize = mainGui.AbsoluteSize
			local dist = guiSize.X * math.abs(sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale - sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale)
			if dist <= 0 then
				dist = 100
			end
			local alpha = math.clamp(sidebarDragStartAlpha - dx / dist, 0, 1)
			sidebarDragAlpha = alpha
			setSidebarPosition(
				UDim2.new(
					sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale + (sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale - sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale) * alpha,
					0,
					0.5,
					0
				)
			)
		end
		NAlib.connect(
			id,
			sidebarGestureFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if not sidebarGestureEnabled then
					return
				end
				if
					input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					return
				end
				sidebarDragAlpha = getSidebarAlpha()
				sidebarDragStartAlpha = sidebarDragAlpha
				sidebarDragStartX = input.Position.X
				sidebarDragActive = true
			end)
		)
		NAlib.connect(
			id,
			UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
				if not sidebarDragActive or not sidebarGestureEnabled then
					return
				end
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					updateSidebarFromInput(input)
				end
			end)
		)
		NAlib.connect(
			id,
			UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
				if not sidebarDragActive or not sidebarGestureEnabled then
					return
				end
				if
					input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					return
				end
				sidebarDragActive = false
				local curSec = getCurrentSectionName()
				if curSec then
					sidebarCurrentSection = curSec
				end
				local targetPos = sidebarDragAlpha > 0.5 and sidebarOpenPos or sidebarClosedPos
				if TS and sidebar then
					local tw = __lt.cm(
						"TweenService",
						"Create",
						sidebar,
						TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
						{
							Position = UDim2.new(targetPos.X.Scale, targetPos.X.Offset, 0.5, 0),
						}
					)
					tw:Play()
				elseif sidebar then
					setSidebarPosition(targetPos)
				end
				if targetPos == sidebarOpenPos then
					if not sidebarCurrentSection then
						sidebarCurrentSection = getCurrentSectionName()
					end
					setIconForcedHidden(true)
					if mainGui and sidebarCurrentSection then
						for _, n in sectionsList do
							local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(n)
							if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") then
								fr.Visible = n == sidebarCurrentSection
							end
						end
					end
				else
					if mainGui then
						if curSec then
							sidebarCurrentSection = curSec
						end
						for _, n in sectionsList do
							local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(n)
							if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") then
								fr.Visible = false
							end
						end
					end
					setIconForcedHidden(sidebarGestureEnabled)
				end
			end)
		)
		saveSidebarGesture()
	end

local function getAudioExt(path)

	end
	local clean = path:match("([^?#]+)") or path
	local ext = clean:match("%.([%w]+)$")
	if not ext then
		return nil
	end
	ext = ext:lower()
	return MUSIC_EXTS[ext] and ext or nil
end

local function normalizeAudioUrl(url)
	if type(url) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local t = trim(url)
	if t == "" then
		return nil
	end
	t = t:gsub(" ", "%%20")
	t = t:gsub(
		"^https://github%.com/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/blob/([^/]+)/(.+)$",
		"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%1/%2/%3/%4"
	)
	return t
end

local function deriveAudioFileName(url, ext)
	local name = url:match("/([^/%?#]+)") or "track"
	name = name:match("([^?#]+)") or name
	local base = sanitizeFileName(name:gsub("%.[^%.]+$", ""))
	base = base ~= "" and base or "track"
	return string.format("%s_%s.%s", base, hashString(url), ext)
end

			local ext = getAudioExt(path)
			if ext then
				local name = path:match("([^/\\]+)$") or path
				list[#list + 1] = {
					path = path,
					name = name,
					asset = resolveMusicAsset(path),
				}
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return (a.name or ""):lower() < (b.name or ""):lower()
	end)
	return list
end

local function findLocalMusicEntry(query)
	query = trim(query)
	if query == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local lower = query:lower()
	for _, item in scanMusicFiles() do
		local nm = (item.name or ""):lower()
		local base = nm:gsub("%.[^%.]+$", "")
		if lower == nm or lower == base then
			return item
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function downloadMusicAsset(url)
	if
		type(getcustomasset) ~= "function"
		or type(writefile) ~= "function"
		or type(isfile) ~= "function"
		or not ensureMusicFolder()
	then
		return nil, "Custom music requires file support and getcustomasset."
	end
	local norm = normalizeAudioUrl(url)
	local ext = getAudioExt(norm)
	if not norm or not ext then
		return nil, "Unsupported audio format. Use mp3, ogg, flac, or wav."
	end
	local full = MUSIC_CACHE_DIR .. "/" .. deriveAudioFileName(norm, ext)
	local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
	if not (okEx and ex) then
		local data = httpGetBinary(norm)
		if not (type(data) == "string" and data ~= "") then
			return nil, "Failed to download audio."
		end
		local okW = pcall(writefile, full, data)
		if not okW then
			return nil, "Failed to save audio."
		end
	end
	local asset = resolveMusicAsset(full)
	if not asset then
		return nil, "Failed to load audio asset."
	end
	return {
		asset = asset,
		name = full:match("([^/\\]+)$") or full,
		path = full,
	}, nil
end

local function deriveImageFileName(url)
	local name = url:match("/([^/%?#]+)") or "image"
	name = name:match("([^?#]+)") or name
	local base = sanitizeFileName(name:match("(.+)%.") or name)
	return string.format("%s_%s.bin", base ~= "" and base or "image", hashString(url))
end

local function normalizeImageUrl(url, base)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local t = trim(url)
	if t == "" then
		return nil
	end
	if t:match("^rbxassetid://") or t:match("^rbxthumb://") then
		return nil
	end
	if t:match("^https?://") then
		return t
	end
	if t:sub(1, 2) == "//" then
		return "https:" .. t
	end
	if t:sub(1, 1) == "/" then
		return (base or "") .. t
	end
	return base and (base .. "/" .. t) or t
end

local function isMeaningfulImageUrl(url)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return false
	end
	return not url:lower():find("no%-script")
end

function httpGetBinary(url, headers)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local function tryRequest(hdr)
		if type(rq) ~= "function" then
			return nil
		end
		local h = {}
		if type(hdr) == "table" then
			for k, v in hdr do
				h[k] = v
			end
		end
		h["User-Agent"] = h["User-Agent"] or "Roblox/Http/1.1"
		h["Accept"] = h["Accept"] or "*/*"
		local ok, res = pcall(rq, {
			Url = url,
			Method = "GET",
			Headers = h,
		})
		if ok and res then
			local code = res.StatusCode or res.Status or res.status_code or 0
			local body = res.Body or res.body
			if (code == 0 or code >= 200 and code < 300) and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then
				return body
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local data = tryRequest(headers)
	if type(data) == "string" and data ~= "" then
		return data
	end
	local ok2, body2 = pcall(function()
		return game:HttpGet(url)
	end)
	if ok2 and type(body2) == "string" and body2 ~= "" then
		return body2
	end
	return tryRequest(nil)
end

local function downloadImageAsset(url)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	if type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	if not ensureImageFolder() then
		return nil
	end
	local full = IMAGE_CACHE_DIR .. "/" .. deriveImageFileName(url)
	local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
	if not (okEx and ex) then
		local host = url:match("^https?://([^/]+)") or ""
		local hdr
		if host:find("rscripts%.net") then
			hdr = { Referer = RSCRIPTS_BASE }
		elseif host:find("robloxscripts%.com") then
			hdr = { Referer = "https://robloxscripts.com" }
		elseif host:find("haxhell%.com") then
			hdr = { Referer = HAXHELL_BASE }
		elseif host:find("rbxcdn%.com") then
			hdr = { Referer = "https://www.roblox.com/" }
		end
		local data = httpGetBinary(url, hdr)
		if not (type(data) == "string" and data ~= "") then
			return nil
		end
		local okW = pcall(writefile, full, data)
		if not okW then
			return nil
		end
	end
	local okA, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, full)
	if okA and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
		return asset
	end
	return nil
end

local function resolveRoScriptsImage(d)

	end
	local url = normalizeImageUrl(d.image, ROSCRIPTS_BASE)
	if url and isMeaningfulImageUrl(url) then
		return url
	end
	local gameData = type(d.game) == "table" and d.game or nil
	url = normalizeImageUrl(gameData and gameData.image, ROSCRIPTS_BASE)
	if url and isMeaningfulImageUrl(url) then
		return url
	end
	return nil
end

local function resolveHaxHellImage(d)
	if not d then

	end
	local media = type(d.media) == "table" and d.media or {}
	local gameData = type(d.game) == "table" and d.game or {}
	local function pick(vals)
		for _, v in vals do
			local n = normalizeImageUrl(v, HAXHELL_BASE)
			if n and isMeaningfulImageUrl(n) then
				return n
			end
		end
	end
	return pick({

		d.imageUrl,

	else

	end
	if v == nil and type(d.accessType) == "string" then
		v = d.accessType:lower() == "key"
	end
	local k = false
	if type(v) == "boolean" then
		k = v
	elseif type(v) == "number" then
		k = v ~= 0
	elseif type(v) == "string" then
		local s = v:lower()
		if
			s ~= ""
			and s ~= "false"
			and s ~= "0"
			and s ~= "none"
			and s ~= "n/a"
			and not s:find("no key", 1, true)
			and not s:find("keyless", 1, true)
		then
			k = true
		end
	elseif v ~= nil and v ~= false then
		k = true
	end
	if flt == "all" then
		return true
	elseif flt == "keyless" then
		return not k
	else

	end
end

local function getRw(d)
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		return d.rawScript or d.scriptLink or d.raw or "", true
	elseif eng == "RoScripts" then
		local url = d.loadstring or d.rawUrl or ""
		return url, type(url) == "string" and url:match("^https?://") ~= nil
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		local source = d.script or ""
		if source ~= "" then
			return source, false
		end
		local url = d.rawScriptUrl or d.scriptLink or d.raw or ""
		return url, url ~= ""
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local links = type(d.links) == "table" and d.links or {}
		local sourceData = type(d.source) == "table" and d.source or {}
		local source = links.raw or sourceData.rawUrl or sourceData.code or d.rawScriptUrl or d.script or ""
		return source, type(source) == "string" and source:match("^https?://") ~= nil
	end
	return d.script or d.rawScript or d.scriptLink or d.raw or "", false
end

local function getTi(d)
	return d.title or d.name or "Untitled Script"
end

local function getGa(d)
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		return d.game and d.game.title or "Unknown Game"
	end
	return d.game and d.game.name or "Unknown Game"
end

local function keyReq(d)
	local v
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		v = d.keySystem
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local flags = type(d.flags) == "table" and d.flags or {}
		v = flags.keySystem
	else
		v = d.key
	end
	if v == nil and type(d.accessType) == "string" then
		v = d.accessType:lower() == "key"
	end
	local k = false
	if type(v) == "boolean" then
		k = v
	elseif type(v) == "number" then
		k = v ~= 0
	elseif type(v) == "string" then
		local s = v:lower()
		if
			s ~= ""
			and s ~= "false"
			and s ~= "0"
			and s ~= "none"
			and s ~= "n/a"
			and not s:find("no key", 1, true)
			and not s:find("keyless", 1, true)
		then
			k = true
		end
	elseif v ~= nil and v ~= false then
		k = true
	end
	return k
end

local function getInfo(d)
	local stats = type(d.stats) == "table" and d.stats or {}
	local flags = type(d.flags) == "table" and d.flags or {}
	local v = tostring(d.views or d.viewCount or stats.views or 0)
	local l = tostring(d.likes or d.likeCount or stats.likes or 0)
	local k = keyReq(d) and "Key" or "Keyless"
	if eng == "RoScripts" then
		if d.scriptType == "paid" then
			k = "Paid"
		end
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" and type(d.accessType) == "string" then
		local access = d.accessType:lower()
		if access == "paid" then
			k = "Paid"
		elseif access == "free" then
			k = "Free"
		end
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" and flags.isPaid == true then
		k = "Paid"
	end
	local s = eng == "RobloxScripts" and "Published" or (d.isPatched == true or d.patched == true or flags.patched == true) and "Patched" or "Working"
	local info = string.format("%s | Views %s | Likes %s | %s", k, v, l, s)
	if eng == "RScripts" and d.discord and d.discord ~= "" then
		info = info .. " | Discord"
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" and d.author and d.author.verified == true then
		info = info .. " | Verified"
	elseif eng == "RoScripts" then
		if d.verified == true or type(d.owner) == "table" and d.owner.verified == true then
			info = info .. " | Verified"
		end
		if d.universal == true then
			info = info .. " | Universal"
		end
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local verified = flags.verified == true or type(d.author) == "table" and d.author.isScripterVerified == true
		if verified then
			info = info .. " | Verified"
		end
		if flags.mobileSupported == true then
			info = info .. " | Mobile"
		end
	end
	return info
end

local function ren()
	shClr()
	pgt.Text = string.format("Page %d / %d", cur, maxp)
	if not data or #data == 0 then
		shMsg("No scripts found", col.wa)
		return
	end
	local n = 0
	local row
	local coln = 0
	for _, d in data do
		if pass(d) then
			if not row or coln >= 3 then
				row = mkRow()
				coln = 0
			end
			n += 1
			coln += 1
			mkCard(row, n, d)
		end
	end
	if n == 0 then
		if flt == "keyless" then
			shMsg("No keyless scripts found on this page", col.wa)
		elseif flt == "key" then
			shMsg("No key-required scripts found on this page", col.wa)
		else
			shMsg("No scripts found", col.wa)
		end
	end
end

local function fetch(q2, tr2, p2)
	if busy then
		return
	end
	clearImageCache()
	q2 = trim(q2 or "")
	tr2 = eng == "ScriptBlox" and tr2 == true or false
	p2 = math.max(tonumber(p2) or 1, 1)
	q = q2
	tr = tr2
	cur = p2
	maxp = 1
	data = {}
	setBusy(true)
	shClr()
	shMsg("Loading...", col.td)
	local requestQuery = q2
	if eng == "RobloxScripts" and #requestQuery > 100 then
		requestQuery = requestQuery:sub(1, 100)
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" and requestQuery ~= "" and #requestQuery < 2 then
		shClr()
		shMsg("HaxHell search requires at least 2 characters", col.wa)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	end
	local enc = __lt.cm("HttpService", "UrlEncode", requestQuery)
	local u
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		u = string.format("https://rscripts.net/api/v2/scripts?page=%d&orderBy=date&sort=desc", p2)
		if requestQuery ~= "" then
			u = u .. "&q=" .. enc
		end
	elseif eng == "RoScripts" then
		if requestQuery == "" then
			u = string.format("https://api.roscripts.io/v1/scripts?page=%d&max=20&sortBy=updatedAt&order=desc", p2)
		else
			u = string.format("https://api.roscripts.io/v1/scripts/search?q=%s&page=%d&max=20", enc, p2)
		end
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		p2 = math.min(p2, 200)
		cur = p2
		u = string.format("https://robloxscripts.com/api/v1/scripts?page=%d&limit=24&sort=newest", p2)
		if requestQuery ~= "" then
			u = u .. "&q=" .. enc
		end
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		if requestQuery == "" then
			u = string.format("https://haxhell.com/api/v1/scripts?page=%d&limit=24&sort=latest", p2)
		else
			u = string.format("https://haxhell.com/api/v1/search/scripts?q=%s&page=%d&limit=24&sort=latest", enc, p2)
		end
	elseif tr2 then
		u = string.format("https://scriptblox.com/api/script/fetch?page=%d", p2)
	else
		u = string.format("https://scriptblox.com/api/script/search?q=%s&page=%d", enc, p2)
	end
	local dec, status = req(u)
	shClr()
	if status == 429 then
		shMsg("Rate limit reached. Try again shortly", col.wa)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	elseif status == 503 then
		shMsg("API temporarily unavailable", col.wa)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	elseif status ~= 0 and (status < 200 or status >= 300) then
		shMsg("Request failed (" .. tostring(status) .. ")", col.er)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	elseif not dec then
		shMsg("Request failed", col.er)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	end
	local arr
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		arr = dec.scripts
		maxp = math.max(dec.info and dec.info.maxPages or 1, 1)
	elseif eng == "RoScripts" then
		local result = dec.result or {}
		local meta = dec.meta or {}
		arr = type(result.scripts) == "table" and result.scripts or {}
		local pages = tonumber(result.totalPages or meta.totalPages)
		maxp = math.max(math.floor(pages or 1), 1)
		cur = tonumber(result.page or meta.page) or p2
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		arr = dec.data
		local pg = dec.pagination or {}
		local total = tonumber(pg.total or pg.totalItems)
		local limit = tonumber(pg.limit or pg.perPage) or 24
		local pages = tonumber(pg.totalPages or pg.pages or pg.lastPage)
		if not pages and total then
			pages = math.ceil(total / math.max(limit, 1))
		end
		maxp = math.min(math.max(pages or 1, 1), 200)
		cur = tonumber(pg.page or pg.currentPage) or p2
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		arr = dec.data
		local pg = dec.pagination or {}
		local total = tonumber(pg.total or pg.totalItems)
		local limit = tonumber(pg.limit or pg.perPage) or 24
		local pages = tonumber(pg.totalPages or pg.pages or pg.lastPage)
		if not pages and total then
			pages = math.ceil(total / math.max(limit, 1))
		end
		cur = tonumber(pg.page or pg.currentPage) or p2
		if not pages then
			pages = pg.hasMore == true and (cur + 1) or cur
		end
		maxp = math.max(math.floor(pages or 1), 1)
	else
		local r = dec.result or {}
		arr = r.scripts
		maxp = math.max(r.totalPages or 1, 1)
	end
	data = arr or {}
	if #data == 0 then
		shMsg("No scripts found", col.wa)
		pgt.Text = string.format("Page %d / %d", cur, maxp)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	end
	ren()
	setBusy(false)
end

	local mixSaveStamp = 0

	local function queueMixSave()
		if not mixReady then

		mixSaveStamp += 1
		local cur = mixSaveStamp
		task.delay(0.15, function()
			if cur ~= mixSaveStamp then

			musicCfg.volume = vl

	local function formatTime(sec)
		sec = tonumber(sec) or 0
		if sec < 0 or sec ~= sec or sec == math.huge then
			sec = 0
		end
		local total = math.floor(sec + 0.5)
		local m = math.floor(total / 60)
		local s = total % 60
		return string.format("%02d:%02d", m, s)
	end

	local function getNextCycleTrack()
		local mode = st.musicCycleMode
		if mode ~= "order" and mode ~= "random" then
			return nil
		end
		local items = scanMusicFiles()
		if #items == 0 then
			return nil
		end
		local currentRaw = trim(st.musicRaw or "")
		if currentRaw == "" then
			return nil
		end
		local currentLower = currentRaw:lower()
		local currentIndex
		for i, item in items do
			local nm = (item.name or ""):lower()
			local base = nm:gsub("%.[^%.]+$", "")
			if currentLower == nm or currentLower == base then
				currentIndex = i
				break
			end
		end
		if not currentIndex then
			return nil
		end
		if mode == "random" then
			if #items == 1 then
				return items[1]
			end
			local idx = currentIndex
			for _ = 1, 8 do
				idx = math.random(1, #items)
				if idx ~= currentIndex then
					break
				end
			end
			if idx == currentIndex then
				idx = (currentIndex % #items) + 1
			end
			return items[idx]
		end
		return items[(currentIndex % #items) + 1]
	end

	local function apVol(v)
		vl = math.clamp(v, 0, 10)
		local alpha = vl / 10
		vfill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
		vkn.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
		vt.Text = string.format("Volume  %.2f", vl)
		if st.snd then
			st.snd.Volume = vl
		end
		queueMixSave()
	end

	local function apSpeed(v)
		spd = math.clamp(v, 0.5, 2)
		local alpha = (spd - 0.5) / 1.5
		sfill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
		skn.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
		spLabel.Text = string.format("Playback speed  %.2fx", spd)
		if st.snd then
			st.snd.PlaybackSpeed = spd
		end
		queueMixSave()
	end

		local x = (inp.Position.X - sbar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(sbar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)

		x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1)
		local len = st.snd.TimeLength
		local pos = len * x

		end)
		setProgress(x, pos, len)
	end

	local function resolveTrackInput(text)
		local q = trim(text)
		if q == "" then
			return nil, nil, "Enter a valid asset id, filename, or audio URL."
		end
		local localEntry = findLocalMusicEntry(q)
		if localEntry and localEntry.asset then
			return localEntry.asset, localEntry.name
		end
		local sid, raw = getId(q)
		if sid then
			return sid, raw
		end
		if q:match("^https?://") or q:match("^www%.") then
			local entry, err = downloadMusicAsset(q:match("^www%.") and ("https://" .. q) or q)
			if not entry then
				return nil, nil, err or "Failed to download audio."
			end
			return entry.asset, entry.name
		end
		if getAudioExt(q) then
			return nil, nil, "Local track not found in DeltaCustom/DeltaMusic."
		end
		return nil, nil, "Enter a valid asset id, filename, or audio URL."
	end

	end)

	function loadCurrentTrack()
		if localPicker then
			localPicker.close()
		end
		local sid, raw, err = resolveTrackInput(mb.Text)
		if not sid then
			toast("Music", err or "Enter a valid track.")
			return false
		end
		mkSnd(sid, raw)
		syncLocalPicker(raw)
		toast("Music", "Loaded audio.")
		return true
	end

				sidebarRefs.toggle:SetAttribute("LT_OrigPosXO", sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.X.Offset)

do
	local previousThemeRuntime = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaThemeRuntime")
	if type(previousThemeRuntime) == "table" and type(previousThemeRuntime.stop) == "function" then
		pcall(previousThemeRuntime.stop)
	end
	if (identifyexecutor and identifyexecutor() or ""):lower() == "delta" then
		task.defer(function()
			local themeRuntime = {
				alive = true,
				connections = {},
				baseBackground = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
				baseText = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
				baseStroke = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
				baseImage = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
			}
			__dcm_env.__DeltaThemeRuntime = themeRuntime
			local function connectTheme(signal, callback)
				if not signal then
					return
				end
				local ok, connection = pcall(function()
					return signal:Connect(callback)
				end)
				if ok and connection then
					table.insert(themeRuntime.connections, connection)
				end
			end
			local function getThemeRoot()
				local service = cloneref and cloneref(game:GetService("CoreGui")) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
				return gethui and gethui() or service
			end
			local function findMainGui()
				local rootGui = getThemeRoot()
				for _, gui in rootGui:GetChildren() do
					if
						gui:IsA("ScreenGui")
						and gui:FindFirstChild("Executor")
						and gui:FindFirstChild("Settings")
						and gui:FindFirstChild("Sidebar")
					then
						return gui
					end
				end
			end
			local mainGui = findMainGui()
			local attempts = 0
			while themeRuntime.alive and not mainGui and attempts < 100 do
				attempts += 1
				task.wait(0.1)
				mainGui = findMainGui()
			end
			if not (themeRuntime.alive and mainGui) then
				return
			end
			local settingsPath = "DeltaCustom/Settings.json"
			local function readThemeConfig()
				if type(isfile) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" or not isfile(settingsPath) then
					return {}
				end
				local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, settingsPath)
				if not ok or type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then
					return {}
				end
				local decodedOk, decoded = pcall(function()
					return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONDecode", raw)
				end)
				return decodedOk and type(decoded) == "table" and decoded or {}
			end
			local function saveTheme(name)
				local config = readThemeConfig()
				config.DeltaTheme = { name = name }
				writeJsonFile(settingsPath, config)
			end
			local function capture(object)
				if not object then
					return
				end
				if
					object:IsA("Frame")
					or object:IsA("ImageLabel")
					or object:IsA("ImageButton")
					or object:IsA("TextButton")
					or object:IsA("TextBox")
					or object:IsA("ScrollingFrame")

					end
				end

				end

					themeRuntime.baseImage[object] = object.ImageColor3
				end
			end
			capture(mainGui)
			for _, object in mainGui:GetDescendants() do
				capture(object)
			end
			local palettes = {
				Light = {
					root = Color3.fromRGB(242, 244, 248),
					panel = Color3.fromRGB(229, 232, 239),
					card = Color3.fromRGB(216, 221, 230),
					card2 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 211, 221),
					text = Color3.fromRGB(27, 33, 44),
					muted = Color3.fromRGB(91, 101, 118),
					stroke = Color3.fromRGB(178, 188, 204),
					icon = Color3.fromRGB(69, 79, 96),
					accent = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242),
				},
				Amoled = {
					root = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
					panel = Color3.fromRGB(5, 5, 7),
					card = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 13),
					card2 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 19),
					text = Color3.fromRGB(244, 247, 250),
					muted = Color3.fromRGB(143, 150, 162),
					stroke = Color3.fromRGB(29, 30, 36),
					icon = Color3.fromRGB(224, 229, 236),
					accent = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242),
				},
			}
			local function isAccent(color)
				local hue, saturation, value = Color3.toHSV(color)
				return saturation >= 0.34 and value >= 0.28 and hue >= 0.48 and hue <= 0.72
			end
			local function isControlColorPart(object)
				local current = object
				while current and current ~= mainGui do
					local name = current.Name
					if
						name == "Hue"
						or name == "Sat"
						or name == "Val"
						or name == "Knob"
						or name == "ColorSlider"
						or name == "ColorValue"
					then
						return true
					end
					current = current.Parent
				end
				return false
			end
			local function backgroundRole(object, palette)
				local name = string.lower(object.Name or "")
				if name == "darkoverlay" then
					return Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				end
				if
					name:find("overlay")
					or name == "settings"
					or name == "executor"
					or name == "home"
					or name == "scripthub"
					or name == "console"
					or name == "music"
				then
					return palette.root
				end
				if
					name:find("button")
					or name:find("tab")
					or name:find("card")
					or name:find("script")
					or name:find("network")
					or name:find("search")
					or name:find("dropdown")
					or name:find("setting")
				then
					return palette.card
				end
				if object:IsA("TextBox") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("ImageButton") then
					return palette.card2
				end
				return palette.panel
			end
			local function restoreObject(object)
				local background = themeRuntime.baseBackground[object]
				if background ~= nil and object.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						object.BackgroundColor3 = background
					end)
				end
				local textColor = themeRuntime.baseText[object]
				if textColor ~= nil and object.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						object.TextColor3 = textColor
					end)
				end
				local strokeColor = themeRuntime.baseStroke[object]
				if strokeColor ~= nil and object.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						object.Color = strokeColor
					end)
				end
				local imageColor = themeRuntime.baseImage[object]
				if imageColor ~= nil and object.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						object.ImageColor3 = imageColor
					end)
				end
			end
			local function applyObject(object, themeName)
				if object:GetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOverlay") then
					return
				end
				capture(object)
				if themeName == "Default" then
					restoreObject(object)
					return
				end
				local palette = palettes[themeName]
				if not palette or isControlColorPart(object) then
					return
				end
				local background = themeRuntime.baseBackground[object]
				if background ~= nil then
					pcall(function()
						object.BackgroundColor3 = isAccent(background) and background or backgroundRole(object, palette)
					end)
				end
				local textColor = themeRuntime.baseText[object]
				if textColor ~= nil then
					local name = string.lower(object.Name or "")
					pcall(function()
						object.TextColor3 = isAccent(textColor) and textColor
							or ((name == "desc" or name:find("description") or name:find("placeholder")) and palette.muted or palette.text)
					end)
				end
				local strokeColor = themeRuntime.baseStroke[object]
				if strokeColor ~= nil then
					pcall(function()
						object.Color = isAccent(strokeColor) and strokeColor or palette.stroke
					end)
				end
				local imageColor = themeRuntime.baseImage[object]
				if imageColor ~= nil then
					local _, saturation = Color3.toHSV(imageColor)
					local name = string.lower(object.Name or "")
					if saturation <= 0.28 or name == "checked" or name:find("icon") or name == "imagebutton" then
						pcall(function()
							object.ImageColor3 = isAccent(imageColor) and imageColor or (name == "checked" and palette.accent or palette.icon)
						end)
					end
				end
			end
			local function getThemeDropdown()
				local executor = mainGui:FindFirstChild("Executor")
				local image = executor and executor:FindFirstChild("Executor")
				local overlay = image and image:FindFirstChild("Overlay")
				local menu = overlay and overlay:FindFirstChild("Menu", true)
				return menu and menu:FindFirstChild("Dropdown")
			end
			local themeMap = { Option1 = "Default", Option2 = "Light", Option3 = "Amoled" }
			local function syncChecks(themeName)
				local dropdown = getThemeDropdown()
				for optionName, name in themeMap do
					local option = dropdown and dropdown:FindFirstChild(optionName)
					local checked = option and option:FindFirstChild("Checked", true)
					if checked and checked:IsA("GuiObject") then
						checked.Visible = name == themeName
					end
				end
			end
			local currentTheme = "Default"
			local applying = false
			local function applyTheme(themeName, persist)
				if applying or not themeRuntime.alive then
					return
				end
				themeName = themeName == "Light" and "Light" or themeName == "Amoled" and "Amoled" or "Default"
				applying = true
				currentTheme = themeName
				applyObject(mainGui, themeName)
				for _, object in mainGui:GetDescendants() do
					applyObject(object, themeName)
				end
				syncChecks(themeName)
				if persist then
					saveTheme(themeName)
				end
				applying = false
			end
			themeRuntime.applyTheme = applyTheme
			themeRuntime.stop = function()
				if not themeRuntime.alive then
					return
				end
				if currentTheme ~= "Default" then
					applyTheme("Default", false)
				end
				themeRuntime.alive = false
				for i = #themeRuntime.connections, 1, -1 do
					pcall(function()
						themeRuntime.connections[i]:Disconnect()
					end)
				end
				table.clear(themeRuntime.connections)
				if rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaThemeRuntime") == themeRuntime then
					__dcm_env.__DeltaThemeRuntime = nil
				end
			end
			local boundOptions = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			local function bindOption(option, themeName)
				if not (option and option:IsA("GuiButton")) or boundOptions[option] then
					return
				end
				boundOptions[option] = true
				local locked = false
				local function choose()
					if locked then
						return
					end
					locked = true
					task.defer(applyTheme, themeName, true)
					task.delay(0.12, function()
						locked = false
					end)
				end
				connectTheme(option.MouseButton1Click, choose)
				connectTheme(option.Activated, choose)
				connectTheme(option.TouchTap, choose)
			end
			local function bindThemeOptions()
				local dropdown = getThemeDropdown()
				if not dropdown then
					return
				end
				for optionName, themeName in themeMap do
					bindOption(dropdown:FindFirstChild(optionName), themeName)
				end
			end
			bindThemeOptions()
			connectTheme(mainGui.DescendantAdded, function(object)
				task.defer(function()
					if not (themeRuntime.alive and object and object.Parent) then
						return
					end
					capture(object)
					if object:IsA("GuiObject") or object:IsA("UIStroke") then
						applyObject(object, currentTheme)
					end
					if object:IsA("GuiButton") and themeMap[object.Name] and object.Parent and object.Parent.Name == "Dropdown" then
						bindOption(object, themeMap[object.Name])
					end
				end)
			end)
			local config = readThemeConfig()
			local savedTheme = type(config.DeltaTheme) == "table" and config.DeltaTheme.name or nil
			applyTheme(savedTheme, false)
		end)
	end
end

	local function findMainGui()
		local best
		local bestScore = 0
		for _, gui in root:GetChildren() do
			if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
				local score = 0
				for _, name in { "Executor", "Sidebar", "Scripthub", "Settings", "Home", "Console" } do
					if gui:FindFirstChild(name) then
						score += (name == "Executor" or name == "Sidebar") and 4 or 2
					elseif gui:FindFirstChild(name, true) then
						score += 1
					end
				end
				if score > bestScore then
					best = gui
					bestScore = score
				end
			end
		end
		if bestScore >= 10 then
			return best
		end
	end

	local function normalizeSidebarOrder(value)
		local result = {}
		local used = {}
		if type(value) == "table" then
			for _, name in value do
				if sidebarNameSet[name] and not used[name] then
					used[name] = true
					table.insert(result, name)
				end
			end
		end
		local musicWasMissing = not used.Music
		for _, name in sidebarNames do
			if not used[name] then
				used[name] = true
				table.insert(result, name)
			end
		end
		if musicWasMissing then
			local musicIndex = table.find(result, "Music")
			if musicIndex then
				table.remove(result, musicIndex)
				local hubIndex = table.find(result, "Scripthub") or math.min(3, #result)
				table.insert(result, hubIndex + 1, "Music")
			end
		end
		return result
	end

		local target = math.clamp(index + direction, 1, #sidebarOrder)
		if target == index then

		sidebarOrder[index], sidebarOrder[target] = sidebarOrder[target], sidebarOrder[index]
		applySidebarOrder()

			local ai = tonumber(a.Name:match("%d+")) or math.huge
			local bi = tonumber(b.Name:match("%d+")) or math.huge

	runtime.clipboardCache = tostring(runtime.clipboardCache or "")

	local function writeClipboard(value)
		value = tostring(value or "")
		runtime.clipboardCache = value
		local writer = type(setclipboard) == "function" and setclipboard
			or type(toclipboard) == "function" and toclipboard
			or type(setrbxclipboard) == "function" and setrbxclipboard
		if writer then

		return writer ~= nil
	end

	local function readClipboard()
		local reader = type(getclipboard) == "function" and getclipboard
			or type(readclipboard) == "function" and readclipboard
		if reader then
			local ok, value = pcall(reader)
			if ok and type(value) == "string" then
				runtime.clipboardCache = value
				return value, true
			end
		end
		if runtime.clipboardCache ~= "" then
			return runtime.clipboardCache, false
		end
		return nil, false
	end


	local function insertIntoActive(text)
		local box = getActiveCodeBox()
		if not box then
			return false
		end
		text = tostring(text or "")
		local current = box.Text or ""
		local cursor = tonumber(box.CursorPosition) or -1
		if cursor < 1 or cursor > #current + 1 then
			cursor = #current + 1
		end
		box.Text = current:sub(1, cursor - 1) .. text .. current:sub(cursor)
		local nextCursor = cursor + #text
		task.defer(function()
			if box and box.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					box:CaptureFocus()
					box.CursorPosition = nextCursor
					box.SelectionStart = nextCursor
				end)
			end
		end)
		return true
	end

			Description = "Clipboard access is unavailable in this Delta build.",

	local function executeSource(source, chunkName)
		source = tostring(source or "")
		if type(loadstring) ~= "function" then
			notify({
				Title = "Delta Customization",
				Description = "Script execution is unavailable in this Delta build.",
				Duration = 5,
			})
			return false
		end
		local compiled, compileError = loadstring(source, chunkName or "=Delta V2")
		if not compiled then
			notify({
				Title = "Delta V2 compile error",
				Description = tostring(compileError or "Unknown compile error"),
				Duration = 7,
			})
			return false
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, runtimeError = xpcall(compiled, function(message)
				return tostring(message)
			end)
			if not ok then
				notify({
					Title = "Delta V2 runtime error",
					Description = tostring(runtimeError or "Unknown runtime error"),
					Duration = 7,
				})
			end
		end)
		return true
	end

	local function executeActiveCode()

	local function activateOriginal(button)

		if type(firesignal) == "function" then

				for _, signalName in { "MouseButton1Click", "Activated" } do
					local signal = button[signalName]
					local ok, connections = pcall(getconnections, signal)
					if ok and type(connections) == "table" and #connections > 0 then
						local fired = pcall(firesignal, signal)
						if fired then
							return true
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local ok = pcall(firesignal, button.MouseButton1Click)

			end

		return pcall(function()

		button.Size = original.Size
		button.LayoutOrder = original.LayoutOrder
		button.Visible = true
		local title = original.Title
		if title and title.Parent then
			title.Text = original.Text
			title.TextScaled = original.TextScaled
			title.TextSize = original.TextSize
			title.TextTruncate = original.TextTruncate

	local function createToolbarButton(parent, template, name, text, order, callback)
		local button = template:Clone()
		button.Name = name
		removeScripts(button)
		button.Visible = true
		button.Active = true
		button.Interactable = true
		button.Selectable = true
		button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
		button.Size = UDim2.new(1 / 6, -4, 1, -6)
		button.LayoutOrder = order
		button.ZIndex = parent.ZIndex + 1
		button.Parent = parent
		for _, object in button:GetDescendants() do
			if object:IsA("GuiObject") then
				object.ZIndex = button.ZIndex + 1
			end
		end
		setButtonTitle(button, text)
		local title = button:FindFirstChild("Title", true) or button:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
		if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
			title.TextScaled = false
			title.TextSize = buttonsFrame.AbsoluteSize.X < 650 and 10 or 12
			title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		end
		track(button)
		local locked = false
		local function activate()
			if locked or not runtime.alive then
				return
			end
			locked = true
			callback()
			task.delay(0.1, function()
				locked = false
			end)
		end

	editorCanvas = (function()
		local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
		local hooked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local originals = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local resizeTokens = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local originalCanvasSize = codeFrame.CanvasSize
		local originalAutomaticCanvasSize = codeFrame.AutomaticCanvasSize
		local originalCanvasPosition = codeFrame.CanvasPosition

		local function effectiveScale(object)
			local scale = 1
			local current = object
			while current do
				for _, child in current:GetChildren() do
					if child:IsA("UIScale") then
						scale *= child.Scale
					end
				end
				current = current.Parent
			end
			return math.max(scale, 0.05)
		end

		local function remember(box)
			if originals[box] == nil then
				originals[box] = {
					AutomaticSize = box.AutomaticSize,
					Position = box.Position,
					Size = box.Size,
				}
			end
		end

		local function resize(box)
			if not (runtime.alive and box and box.Parent and box:IsA("TextBox")) then
				return
			end
			remember(box)
			local token = (resizeTokens[box] or 0) + 1
			resizeTokens[box] = token
			task.defer(function()
				if not (runtime.alive and box.Parent and resizeTokens[box] == token) then
					return
				end
				local scale = effectiveScale(codeFrame)
				local windowWidth = math.max(140, math.floor(codeFrame.AbsoluteWindowSize.X / scale))
				local windowHeight = math.max(100, math.floor(codeFrame.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y / scale))
				local availableTextWidth = math.max(120, windowWidth - 20)
				local text = box.Text ~= "" and box.Text or " "
				local params = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
				params.Text = text
				params.Width = box.TextWrapped and availableTextWidth or 1000000
				params.Font = box.FontFace
				params.Size = box.TextSize
				local ok, bounds = pcall(function()
					return TextService:GetTextBoundsAsync(params)
				end)
				params:Destroy()
				local _, lineBreaks = (box.Text or ""):gsub("\n", "\n")
				local lineHeight = math.max(1, box.LineHeight) * box.TextSize
				local minimumTextHeight = math.ceil((lineBreaks + 1) * lineHeight)
				if not ok then
					bounds = Vector2.new(availableTextWidth, minimumTextHeight)
				end
				if not (runtime.alive and box.Parent and resizeTokens[box] == token) then
					return
				end
				local measuredWidth = math.ceil(bounds.X)
				local measuredHeight = math.max(math.ceil(bounds.Y), minimumTextHeight)
				local contentWidth = box.TextWrapped
					and availableTextWidth
					or math.max(availableTextWidth, measuredWidth + 28)
				local contentHeight = math.max(windowHeight - 12, measuredHeight + math.ceil(lineHeight) + 28)
				local canvasWidth = box.TextWrapped
					and windowWidth
					or math.max(windowWidth, 8 + contentWidth + 32)
				local canvasHeight = math.max(windowHeight, 6 + contentHeight + 36)
				box.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
				box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6)
				box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(contentWidth, contentHeight)
				if box.Visible then
					codeFrame.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
					codeFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(canvasWidth, canvasHeight)
					local maximumX = math.max(0, canvasWidth - windowWidth)
					local maximumY = math.max(0, canvasHeight - windowHeight)
					codeFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(
						math.clamp(codeFrame.CanvasPosition.X, 0, maximumX),
						math.clamp(codeFrame.CanvasPosition.Y, 0, maximumY)
					)
				end
			end)
		end

		local function hook(box)
			if hooked[box] or not box:IsA("TextBox") or not box.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				return
			end
			hooked[box] = true
			remember(box)
			for _, property in { "Text", "Visible", "TextWrapped", "TextSize", "FontFace", "LineHeight" } do
				connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), function()
					resize(box)
				end)
			end
			resize(box)
		end

		local function resizeAll()
			for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
				hook(box)
				resize(box)
			end
		end

		local function restore()
			if codeFrame and codeFrame.Parent then
				codeFrame.AutomaticCanvasSize = originalAutomaticCanvasSize
				codeFrame.CanvasSize = originalCanvasSize
				codeFrame.CanvasPosition = originalCanvasPosition
			end
			for box, values in originals do
				if box and box.Parent then
					box.AutomaticSize = values.AutomaticSize
					box.Position = values.Position
					box.Size = values.Size
				end
			end
		end

		connect(codeFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), resizeAll)
		pcall(function()
			connect(codeFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteWindowSize"), resizeAll)
		end)
		return { hook = hook, resize = resize, resizeAll = resizeAll, restore = restore }
	end)()

		local function escape(value)

			local background = codeFrame.BackgroundColor3
			local light = background.R * 0.299 + background.G * 0.587 + background.B * 0.114 > 0.58
			if light then
				return {
					text = Color3.fromRGB(25, 30, 42), keyword = "#AF00DB", builtin = "#267F99",
					global = "#001080", func = "#795E26", string = "#A31515",
					number = "#098658", comment = "#008000", executor = "#B44700",

			return {
				text = Color3.fromRGB(218, 222, 232), keyword = "#C586C0", builtin = "#4EC9B0",
				global = "#9CDCFE", func = "#DCDCAA", string = "#CE9178",
				number = "#B5CEA8", comment = "#6A9955", executor = "#FF9E64",
