		local function paint(value, color)
			return '<font color="' .. color .. '">' .. escape(value) .. "</font>"
		end

		local function longBracketAt(source, index)
			local equals = source:sub(index):match("^%[(=*)%[")
			if equals == nil then
				return nil
			end
			local closing = "]" .. equals .. "]"
			local finish = source:find(closing, index + #equals + 2, true)
			return finish and finish + #closing - 1 or #source
		end

		local function tokenize(source)
			local colors = palette()
			local output = table.create(math.max(32, math.floor(#source / 6)))
			local index = 1
			local expectFunctionName = false
			while index <= #source do
				local char = source:sub(index, index)
				local pair = source:sub(index, index + 1)
				if pair == "--" then
					local longFinish = longBracketAt(source, index + 2)
					local finish = longFinish or ((source:find("\n", index + 2, true) or (#source + 1)) - 1)
					output[#output + 1] = paint(source:sub(index, finish), colors.comment)
					index = finish + 1
				elseif char == "\"" or char == "'" then
					local quote = char
					local finish = index + 1
					while finish <= #source do
						local current = source:sub(finish, finish)
						if current == "\\" then
							finish += 2
						elseif current == quote then
							break
						else
							finish += 1
						end
					end
					finish = math.min(finish, #source)
					output[#output + 1] = paint(source:sub(index, finish), colors.string)
					index = finish + 1
				elseif char == "[" then
					local finish = longBracketAt(source, index)
					if finish then
						output[#output + 1] = paint(source:sub(index, finish), colors.string)
						index = finish + 1
					else
						output[#output + 1] = escape(char)
						index += 1
					end
				elseif char:match("[%a_]") then
					local finish = index
					while finish < #source and source:sub(finish + 1, finish + 1):match("[%w_]") do
						finish += 1
					end
					local word = source:sub(index, finish)
					local color
					if keywords[word] then
						color = colors.keyword
						expectFunctionName = word == "function"
					elseif exploitSyntaxEnabled and executorApis[word] then
						color = colors.executor
					elseif builtins[word] then
						color = colors.builtin
					elseif globals[word] then
						color = colors.global
					else
						local nextIndex = finish + 1
						while nextIndex <= #source and source:sub(nextIndex, nextIndex):match("%s") do
							nextIndex += 1
						end
						if expectFunctionName or source:sub(nextIndex, nextIndex) == "(" then
							color = colors.func
						end
						expectFunctionName = false
					end
					output[#output + 1] = color and paint(word, color) or escape(word)
					index = finish + 1
				elseif char:match("%d") or (char == "." and source:sub(index + 1, index + 1):match("%d")) then
					local rest = source:sub(index)
					local number = rest:match("^0[xX][%da-fA-F_]+")

						or rest:match("^%d[%d_]*%.?[%d_]*[eE][+-]?[%d_]+")
						or rest:match("^%.%d[%d_]*[eE][+-]?[%d_]+")
						or rest:match("^%d[%d_]*%.?[%d_]*")
						or rest:match("^%.%d[%d_]*")
					number = number ~= "" and number or char
					output[#output + 1] = paint(number, colors.number)
					index += #number
				else
					output[#output + 1] = escape(char)
					index += 1
				end
			end
			return table.concat(output), colors.text
		end

		local function sync(box)
			local state = overlays[box]
			if not state then

			label.TextYAlignment = box.TextYAlignment

			label.TextSize = box.TextSize
			label.LineHeight = box.LineHeight

				box.TextTransparency = 1
				box.ZIndex = state.originalZ + 1

			else
				box.TextTransparency = state.originalTransparency

			} do

				end
				if state.label and state.label.Parent then

			end

		end

		connect(codeFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"), applyAll)
		return { hook = hook, sync = queue, applyAll = applyAll, restore = restore }
	end)()

	local normalizingTabs = false

	local managedCloseBusy = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local normalizeTabSequence

	local function getOrderedTabButtons()
		local entries = {}
		for ordinal, tab in tabsFrame:GetChildren() do
			if tab:IsA("GuiButton") and tab.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				table.insert(entries, { tab = tab, ordinal = ordinal })
			end
		end
		table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
			local ao = a.tab.LayoutOrder
			local bo = b.tab.LayoutOrder
			if ao ~= bo then
				return ao < bo
			end
			local ai = tonumber(a.tab.Name:match("%d+")) or math.huge
			local bi = tonumber(b.tab.Name:match("%d+")) or math.huge
			if ai ~= bi then
				return ai < bi
			end
			return a.ordinal < b.ordinal
		end)
		local result = {}
		for _, entry in entries do
			table.insert(result, entry.tab)
		end
		return result
	end

	local function closeManagedTab(tab)
		if not (runtime.alive and tab and tab.Parent) then
			return
		end
		local tabs = getOrderedTabButtons()
		if #tabs <= 1 then
			return
		end
		local index = table.find(tabs, tab)
		if not index then
			return
		end
		local boxes = getCodeBoxes()
		local box = boxes[index]
		local wasVisible = box and box.Visible or false
		if tab.Parent then
			tab:Destroy()
		end
		if box and box.Parent then
			box:Destroy()
		end
		task.defer(function()
			if not runtime.alive then
				return
			end
			normalizeTabSequence()
			if wasVisible then
				local remaining = getCodeBoxes()
				local nextBox = remaining[math.min(index, #remaining)] or remaining[#remaining]
				if nextBox then
					for _, current in remaining do
						current.Visible = current == nextBox
					end
					for _, currentTab in getOrderedTabButtons() do
						currentTab.BackgroundTransparency = currentTab.Name == nextBox.Name and 0 or 1
					end
				end
			end
			queueStatusUpdate()
		end)
	end

	local function bindManagedClose(tab)
		if not (tab and tab:IsA("GuiButton")) or managedCloseBound[tab] then
			return
		end
		local closeButton = tab:FindFirstChild("ImageButton")
		if not (closeButton and closeButton:IsA("GuiButton")) then
			return
		end
		managedCloseBound[tab] = true
		local function activateClose()
			if managedCloseBusy[tab] then
				return
			end
			managedCloseBusy[tab] = true
			closeManagedTab(tab)
			task.delay(0.1, function()
				managedCloseBusy[tab] = nil
			end)
		end
		connect(closeButton.MouseButton1Click, activateClose)
		connect(closeButton.Activated, activateClose)
	end

	local function normalizeSavedTabFiles()
		local directory = tabDirectory
		if
			type(isfolder) ~= "function"
			or type(listfiles) ~= "function"
			or type(readfile) ~= "function"
			or type(writefile) ~= "function"
			or not isfolder(directory)
		then
			return
		end
		local ok, files = pcall(listfiles, directory)
		if not ok or type(files) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local saved = {}
		for _, path in files do
			local name = tostring(path):match("([^/\\]+)$")
			local index = name and tonumber(name:match("^script(%d+)%.lua$"))
			if index then
				local readOk, text = pcall(readfile, path)
				if readOk and type(text) == "string" then
					table.insert(saved, { index = index, name = name, text = text })
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(saved, function(a, b)
			return a.index < b.index
		end)
		local keep = {}
		for index, item in saved do
			local name = "script" .. tostring(index) .. ".lua"
			keep[name] = true
			pcall(writefile, directory .. "/" .. name, item.text)
		end
		if type(delfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" then
			for _, item in saved do
				if not keep[item.name] then
					local path = directory .. "/" .. item.name
					if isfile(path) then
						pcall(delfile, path)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	normalizeTabSequence = function()
		if normalizingTabs or not runtime.alive then
			return
		end
		normalizingTabs = true
		local boxes = getCodeBoxes()
		local tabs = getOrderedTabButtons()
		local usedTabs = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local entries = {}
		local keep = {}
		for index, box in boxes do
			local oldName = box.Name
			local newName = "script" .. tostring(index) .. ".lua"
			keep[newName] = true
			local tab
			for _, candidate in tabs do
				if not usedTabs[candidate] and candidate.Name == oldName then
					tab = candidate
					break
				end
			end
			if not tab then
				for _, candidate in tabs do
					if not usedTabs[candidate] then
						tab = candidate
						break
					end
				end
			end
			if tab then
				usedTabs[tab] = true
			end
			table.insert(entries, {
				box = box,
				tab = tab,
				oldName = oldName,
				newName = newName,
				text = box.Text or "",
			})
		end
		for _, tab in tabs do
			if not usedTabs[tab] and tab.Parent then
				tab:Destroy()
			end
		end
		for index, entry in entries do
			if entry.box.Parent then
				entry.box.Name = entry.newName
			end
			local tab = entry.tab
			if tab and tab.Parent then
				tab.Name = entry.newName
				tab.LayoutOrder = index
				local title = tab:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
				if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
					title.Text = entry.newName
				end
				bindManagedClose(tab)
			end
		end
		if type(writefile) == "function" then
			for _, entry in entries do
				pcall(writefile, tabDirectory .. "/" .. entry.newName, entry.text)
			end
		end
		if type(delfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" then
			for _, entry in entries do
				if entry.oldName ~= entry.newName and not keep[entry.oldName] then
					local path = tabDirectory .. "/" .. entry.oldName
					if isfile(path) then
						pcall(delfile, path)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		queueStatusUpdate()
		normalizingTabs = false
	end

	local function savedTabNames()
		normalizeSavedTabFiles()
		local names = {}
		local directory = "DeltaCustom/DeltaTabs"
		if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or type(listfiles) ~= "function" or not isfolder(directory) then
			return names
		end
		local ok, files = pcall(listfiles, directory)
		if not ok or type(files) ~= "table" then
			return names
		end
		for _, path in files do
			local name = tostring(path):match("([^/\\]+)$")
			if name and name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				table.insert(names, name)
			end
		end
		table.sort(names, function(a, b)
			return (tonumber(a:match("%d+")) or math.huge) < (tonumber(b:match("%d+")) or math.huge)
		end)
		return names
	end

	local function fireAddTab(addButton)
		local before = #getCodeBoxes()
		local fired = activateOriginal(addButton)
		if not fired then
			return false
		end
		local deadline = os.clock() + 0.5
		repeat
			task.wait()
		until #getCodeBoxes() > before or os.clock() >= deadline
		return #getCodeBoxes() > before
	end

	local function selectTabByName(name)
		for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
			box.Visible = box.Name == name
		end
		for _, tab in tabsFrame:GetChildren() do
			if tab:IsA("GuiButton") and tab.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				tab.BackgroundTransparency = tab.Name == name and 0 or 1
			end
		end

	local function nextAvailableTabName()
		local used = {}
		for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
			used[tonumber(box.Name:match("%d+"))] = true
		end
		local index = 1
		while used[index] do
			index += 1
		end
		return "script" .. tostring(index) .. ".lua"
	end

	local function createFallbackTab(name)
		if tabsFrame:FindFirstChild(name) and codeFrame:FindFirstChild(name, true) then
			return true
		end
		local sourceTab
		for _, object in tabsFrame:GetChildren() do
			if object:IsA("GuiButton") and object.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				sourceTab = object
				break
			end
		end
		local sourceBox = getCodeBoxes()[1]
		if not (sourceTab and sourceBox) then
			return false
		end
		local index = tonumber(name:match("%d+")) or (#getCodeBoxes() + 1)
		local tab = sourceTab:Clone()
		tab.Name = name
		tab.LayoutOrder = index
		tab.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		removeScripts(tab)
		local title = tab:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
			title.Text = name
		end
		tab.Parent = tabsFrame
		track(tab)
		local box = sourceBox:Clone()
		box.Name = name
		box.Text = ""
		box.Visible = false
		box.Parent = sourceBox.Parent
		track(box)
		connect(tab.MouseButton1Click, function()
			selectTabByName(name)
		end)
		local closeButton = tab:FindFirstChild("ImageButton")
		if closeButton and closeButton:IsA("GuiButton") then
			connect(closeButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
				if #getCodeBoxes() <= 1 then
					return
				end
				local wasVisible = box.Visible
				if type(delfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" then
					local path = tabDirectory .. "/" .. name
					if isfile(path) then
						pcall(delfile, path)
					end
				end
				if tab.Parent then
					tab:Destroy()
				end
				if box.Parent then
					box:Destroy()
				end
				if wasVisible then
					local remaining = getCodeBoxes()[1]
					if remaining then
						selectTabByName(remaining.Name)
					end
				end
				queueStatusUpdate()
			end)
		end
		return true
	end

	local restoringTabs = false
	local function restoreSavedTabs(showResult)
		if restoringTabs or not runtime.alive then
			return
		end
		restoringTabs = true
		normalizeTabSequence()
		local saved = savedTabNames()
		local addButton = tabsFrame:FindFirstChild("AddTab")
		local before = #getCodeBoxes()
		local target = 0
		for _, name in saved do
			target = math.max(target, tonumber(name:match("%d+")) or 0)
		end
		local attemptsMade = 0
		while runtime.alive and #getCodeBoxes() < target and attemptsMade < math.max(target * 3, 8) do
			attemptsMade += 1
			local nextIndex = #getCodeBoxes() + 1
			local created = addButton and fireAddTab(addButton) or false
			if not created then
				created = createFallbackTab("script" .. tostring(nextIndex) .. ".lua")
			end
			if not created then
				break
			end
			task.wait(0.08)
		end
		local boxes = getCodeBoxes()
		if type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" then
			for _, box in boxes do
				local path = "DeltaCustom/DeltaTabs/" .. box.Name
				if isfile(path) then
					local ok, text = pcall(readfile, path)
					if ok and type(text) == "string" then
						box.Text = text
					end
				end
				hookCodeBox(box)
			end
		end
		queueStatusUpdate()
		if showResult then
			local after = #boxes
			local description
			if #saved == 0 then
				description = "No saved tabs were found."
			elseif after >= target then
				description = string.format("Restored %d saved tab%s.", #saved, #saved == 1 and "" or "s")
			else
				description = string.format("Restored %d of %d saved tabs.", math.max(after - before, 0), #saved)
			end
			notify({
				Title = "Delta Customization",
				Description = description,
				Duration = 4,
			})
		end
		restoringTabs = false
	end

	local function findSettingsTemplate()
		local settings = v2Main:FindFirstChild("Settings") or v2Main:FindFirstChild("Settings", true)
		local holder = settings and settings:FindFirstChild("Holder")
		if not holder then
			return nil, nil
		end
		local template
		for _, child in holder:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("Frame") and child.Name == "Button" then
				template = child
				break
			end
		end
		return holder, template
	end

	local function createSettingRow(name, titleText, descText, buttonText, callback)
		local holder, template = findSettingsTemplate()
		if not (holder and template) then
			return nil, nil
		end
		local existing = holder:FindFirstChild(name)
		if existing then
			existing:Destroy()
		end
		local row = template:Clone()
		row.Name = name
		row.Visible = true
		row.LayoutOrder = -2
		removeScripts(row)
		local title = row:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local desc = row:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
			title.Text = titleText
		end
		if desc and desc:IsA("TextLabel") then
			desc.Text = descText
		end
		local button = row:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		if button and button:IsA("GuiObject") then
			setButtonTitle(button, buttonText)
			if button:IsA("GuiButton") then
				button.Active = true
				button.Interactable = true
				local locked = false
				local function activate()
					if locked or not runtime.alive then
						return
					end
					locked = true
					callback()
					task.delay(0.1, function()
						locked = false
					end)
				end
				connect(button.MouseButton1Click, activate)
				connect(button.Activated, activate)
				connect(button.TouchTap, activate)
			else
				connect(button.InputEnded, function(input)
					if
						input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
					then
						callback()
					end
				end)
			end
		end
		row.Parent = holder
		track(row)
		return row, button
	end

		for _, property in properties do

				local ok, value = pcall(function()

				if ok then

	newUi.lock = function(object, property, resolver)
		if not object then
			return nil
		end
		newUi.capture(object, { property })
		local state = {
			object = object,
			property = property,
			resolver = resolver,
			busy = false,
		}
		state.apply = function()
			if state.busy or not (newUi.enabled and newUi.applied and object.Parent) then
				return
			end
			local value = type(resolver) == "function" and resolver() or resolver
			local ok, current = pcall(function()
				return object[property]
			end)
			if ok and current ~= value then
				state.busy = true
				pcall(function()
					object[property] = value
				end)
				state.busy = false
			end
		end
		table.insert(newUi.locks, state)
		newUi.connect(object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), function()
			if not state.busy then
				task.defer(state.apply)
			end
		end)
		state.apply()
		return state
	end

	newUi.refreshOrder = function()
		if not (newUi.navBar and newUi.navBar.Parent) then
			return
		end
		local ordered = newUi.getOrderedPages()
		for index, pageName in ordered do
			local entry = newUi.pageButtons[pageName]
			if entry and entry.button then
				entry.button.LayoutOrder = index
			end
		end
		local width = (#ordered * 64) + (math.max(#ordered - 1, 0) * 4) + 24
		newUi.navBar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 80)
		if newUi.closeButton then
			newUi.closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.53, -(math.floor(width / 2) + 49), 0.015, 0)

	newUi.refreshNav = function()
		local visible = newUi.enabled and newUi.applied and newUi.open
		if newUi.navBar then
			newUi.navBar.Visible = visible
		end
		if newUi.closeButton then
			newUi.closeButton.Visible = visible
		end
		if newUi.rail then
			newUi.rail.Visible = visible and newUi.activePage == "Executor"
		end
		for pageName, entry in newUi.pageButtons do
			local active = visible and newUi.activePage == pageName
			entry.button.BackgroundTransparency = active and 0 or 1
			if entry.icon:IsA("ImageLabel") then
				entry.icon.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				entry.icon.ImageTransparency = active and 0 or 0.1
			elseif entry.icon:IsA("TextLabel") then
				entry.icon.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				entry.icon.TextTransparency = active and 0 or 0.1
			end
		end
	end

	newUi.syncPages = function()
		if not (newUi.enabled and newUi.applied) then
			return
		end
		newUi.applying = true
		for _, pageName in newUi.pageNames do
			local page = newUi.getPage(pageName)
			if page then
				page.Visible = newUi.open and pageName == newUi.activePage
			end
		end
		if sidebar and sidebar.Parent then
			sidebar.Visible = false
		end
		newUi.applying = false
		newUi.refreshNav()
		newUi.setIconHidden(newUi.open)
	end

	newUi.showPage = function(pageName)
		if not (newUi.enabled and newUi.applied and newUi.pageSet[pageName]) then
			return
		end
		newUi.activePage = pageName
		newUi.open = true
		newUi.syncPages()
		newUi.applyLocks()
		if pageName == "Executor" then
			newUi.rebuildTabs()
			task.defer(editorCanvas.resizeAll)
			task.defer(updateStatusPosition)
		end
	end

		if not (newUi.enabled and newUi.applied) then

		newUi.open = open and true or false

		newUi.applyLocks()

	newUi.updateLineNumbers = function()
		if not (newUi.lineGutter and newUi.lineNumbers and newUi.enabled and newUi.applied) then
			return
		end
		local box = getActiveCodeBox()
		if not box then
			newUi.lineNumbers.Text = ""
			return
		end
		local text = box.Text or ""
		local _, breaks = text:gsub("\n", "\n")
		local count = math.min(breaks + 1, 5000)
		local numbers = table.create(count)
		for index = 1, count do
			numbers[index] = tostring(index)
		end
		local lineHeight = math.max(1, box.LineHeight)
		newUi.lineNumbers.Text = table.concat(numbers, "\n")
		newUi.lineNumbers.TextSize = box.TextSize
		newUi.lineNumbers.LineHeight = lineHeight
		newUi.lineNumbers.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6 - codeFrame.CanvasPosition.Y)
		newUi.lineNumbers.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, math.max(newUi.lineGutter.AbsoluteSize.Y, math.ceil(count * box.TextSize * lineHeight) + 20))
	end

	newUi.getNativeTabTitle = function(tab)
		local title = tab and (tab:FindFirstChild("Title", true) or tab:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true))
		local value = title and title:IsA("TextLabel") and title.Text ~= "" and title.Text or tab and tab.Name or "New tab"
		local index = tostring(value):match("^script(%d+)%.lua$")
		if index then
			return tonumber(index) == 1 and "New tab" or "New tab " .. index
		end
		return value
	end

	newUi.getNativeClose = function(tab)
		if not tab then
			return nil
		end
		for _, descendant in tab:GetDescendants() do
			if descendant:IsA("GuiButton") then
				return descendant
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	newUi.rebuildTabs = function()
		if not (newUi.enabled and newUi.applied and newUi.tabBar and newUi.tabBar.Parent) then
			return
		end
		newUi.clearTabConnections()
		for _, child in newUi.tabBar:GetChildren() do
			if child:GetAttribute("LT_CustomTab") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local nativeTabs = {}
		for _, tab in tabsFrame:GetChildren() do
			if tab:IsA("GuiButton") and tab.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				table.insert(nativeTabs, tab)
			end
		end
		table.sort(nativeTabs, function(a, b)
			return (a.LayoutOrder ~= b.LayoutOrder and a.LayoutOrder < b.LayoutOrder)
				or (a.LayoutOrder == b.LayoutOrder and a.Name < b.Name)
		end)
		for index, nativeTab in nativeTabs do
			local box = codeFrame:FindFirstChild(nativeTab.Name, true)
			local active = box and box:IsA("TextBox") and box.Visible
			local button = newUi.makeTransient("ImageButton", nativeTab.Name, newUi.tabBar)
			button:SetAttribute("LT_CustomTab", true)
			button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(184, 54)
			button.LayoutOrder = index
			button.BackgroundColor3 = active and newUi.colors.active or newUi.colors.button
			button.BackgroundTransparency = active and 0 or 0.12
			button.BorderSizePixel = 0
			button.AutoButtonColor = false
			button.Image = ""
			button.ZIndex = 12010
			newUi.makeCorner(button, 16, true)
			if not active then
				newUi.makeStroke(button, newUi.colors.buttonStroke, 0.5, 1, true)
			end
			local documentHolder = newUi.makeTransient("Frame", "DocumentHolder", button)
			documentHolder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
			documentHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, 0)
			documentHolder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
			documentHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			documentHolder.ZIndex = 12011
			newUi.makeDocumentIcon(documentHolder, 22, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 12012, true, true)
			local title = newUi.makeTransient("TextLabel", "Title", button)
			title.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
			title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 45, 0.5, 0)
			title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -78, 1, 0)
			title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
			title.Text = newUi.getNativeTabTitle(nativeTab)
			title.TextColor3 = newUi.colors.text
			title.TextSize = 15
			title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			title.ZIndex = 12011
			local close = newUi.makeTransient("ImageButton", "Close", button)
			close.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
			close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0)
			close.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30)
			close.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			close.BorderSizePixel = 0
			close.AutoButtonColor = false
			close.Image = ""
			close.ZIndex = 12012
			newUi.makeXIcon(close, 15, Color3.fromRGB(214, 223, 231), 12013, true)
			newUi.bindTabClick(button, function()
				selectTabByName(nativeTab.Name)
				task.defer(newUi.rebuildTabs)
				task.defer(editorCanvas.resizeAll)
			end)
			newUi.bindTabClick(close, function()
				local nativeClose = newUi.getNativeClose(nativeTab)
				if nativeClose then
					activateOriginal(nativeClose)
				else
					local nativeBox = codeFrame:FindFirstChild(nativeTab.Name, true)
					if nativeBox then
						nativeBox:Destroy()
					end
					nativeTab:Destroy()
				end
				task.delay(0.08, function()
					local activeBox = getActiveCodeBox()
					if not activeBox then
						local first = tabsFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton")
						if first and first.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
							selectTabByName(first.Name)
						end
					end
					newUi.rebuildTabs()
				end)
			end)
		end
		newUi.updateTabCanvas()
		newUi.updateLineNumbers()
	end

	newUi.bindCodeBox = function(box)
		if not (box and box:IsA("TextBox") and box.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") and not newUi.codeBound[box]) then
			return
		end
		newUi.codeBound[box] = true
		newUi.connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
			task.defer(newUi.rebuildTabs)
		end)
		newUi.connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"), function()
			task.defer(newUi.rebuildTabs)
		end)
		for _, property in { "Text", "TextSize", "LineHeight" } do
			newUi.connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), function()
				task.defer(newUi.updateLineNumbers)
			end)
		end
	end

	newUi.enable = function()
		if newUi.applied then
			newUi.enabled = true
			newUi.setOpen(newUi.open)
			return
		end
		local visiblePage = newUi.getCurrentSectionName()
		newUi.enabled = true
		newUi.applied = true
		newUi.open = visiblePage ~= nil
		if visiblePage and newUi.pageSet[visiblePage] then
			newUi.activePage = visiblePage
		else
			for _, pageName in newUi.pageNames do
				local page = newUi.getPage(pageName)
				if page and page.Visible then
					newUi.activePage = pageName
					newUi.open = true
					break
				end
			end
		end
		NAlib.disconnect("Sidebar_NormalizeGeometry")
		NAlib.disconnect("SidebarGesture")
		NAlib.disconnect("ManagedIcon_Toggle")
		local gesture = v2Main:FindFirstChild("SidebarGestureZone", true)
		if gesture and gesture:IsA("GuiObject") then
			newUi.capture(gesture, { "Visible", "Active" })
			gesture.Visible = false
			gesture.Active = false
		end
		newUi.buildShell()
		newUi.buildPages()
		newUi.buildExecutor()
		newUi.bindIcon()
		newUi.syncPages()
		newUi.applyLocks()
		newUi.refreshOrder()
		newUi.refreshNav()
		task.defer(editorCanvas.resizeAll)
		task.defer(updateStatusPosition)

	newUi.disable = function(fullUnload)
		if not newUi.applied then
			newUi.enabled = false
			return
		end
		local wasOpen = newUi.open
		local lastPage = newUi.activePage
		newUi.enabled = false
		newUi.applied = false
		newUi.clearTabConnections()
		for i = #newUi.connections, 1, -1 do
			pcall(function()
				newUi.connections[i]:Disconnect()
			end)
		end
		table.clear(newUi.connections)
		for i = #newUi.created, 1, -1 do
			local object = newUi.created[i]
			if object and object.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					object:Destroy()
				end)
			end
		end
		table.clear(newUi.created)
		for object, state in newUi.originals do
			if object then
				local parentState = state.Parent
				if parentState then
					pcall(function()
						object.Parent = parentState.value
					end)
				end
				for property, wrapped in state do
					if property ~= "Parent" then
						pcall(function()
							object[property] = wrapped.value
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		table.clear(newUi.detached)
		newUi.originals = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		newUi.pageButtons = {}
		newUi.codeBound = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		newUi.locks = {}
		newUi.navBar = nil
		newUi.closeButton = nil
		newUi.tabBar = nil
		newUi.tabLayout = nil
		newUi.lineGutter = nil
		newUi.lineNumbers = nil
		newUi.addButton = nil
		newUi.toolbar = nil
		newUi.rail = nil
		newUi.railTop = nil
		newUi.railToggle = nil
		newUi.railToggleIcon = nil
		__dcm_env.__NewDeltaUIToggle = nil
		if not fullUnload then
			if lastPage and newUi.pageSet[lastPage] then
				local iconApi = newUi.getIconApi()
				if iconApi and type(iconApi.setCurrentSection) == "function" then
					pcall(iconApi.setCurrentSection, lastPage)
				end
			end
			newUi.setClassicOpen(wasOpen)
			local iconApi = rawget(__dcm_env, "DeltaIcon")
			if type(iconApi) == "table" and type(iconApi.rebindToggle) == "function" then
				task.defer(iconApi.rebindToggle)
			end
			task.defer(applySidebarOrder)
			task.defer(applyWideEditor)
			task.defer(applyCompactTabs)
			task.defer(applyToolbarLayout)
			task.defer(editorCanvas.resizeAll)
			task.defer(updateStatusPosition)
		end
	end

		"Resizes Delta's native controls and adds Copy, Paste, and Add Line",
		editorToolbarEnabled,
		function(enabled)
			editorToolbarEnabled = enabled
			saveBool("EditorToolbar", enabled)
			buildToolbar()
			applyToolbarLayout()
		end
	)

	createSettingRow(
		"LT_SidebarButtonOrder",
		"Sidebar button order",
		"Reorders the classic sidebar and the recreated top navigation, including Music",
		"SORT",
		function()
			local menu = ensureSidebarSortMenu()
			refreshSidebarSortMenu()
			menu.Visible = not menu.Visible
		end
	)

	createToggleSetting(
		"LT_EditorStatusSetting",
		"Editor statistics",
		"Shows the active tab, line count, character count and autosave state",
		editorStatusEnabled,
		function(enabled)
			editorStatusEnabled = enabled
			saveBool("EditorStatus", enabled)
			queueStatusUpdate()
		end
	)

	createSettingRow(
		"LT_RestoreTabsNow",
		"Restore saved tabs now",
		"Rebuilds any missing tabs from DeltaCustom/DeltaTabs",
		"RESTORE",
		function()
			task.spawn(restoreSavedTabs, true)
		end
	)

	createToggleSetting(
		"LT_WideEditor",
		"Wide editor",
		"Hides the executor side cards and gives the code editor more room",
		wideEditorEnabled,
		function(enabled)
			wideEditorEnabled = enabled
			saveBool("WideEditor", enabled)
			applyWideEditor()
		end
	)

	createToggleSetting(
		"LT_CompactTabs",
		"Compact editor tabs",
		"Fits more script tabs across the executor tab bar",
		compactTabsEnabled,
		function(enabled)
			compactTabsEnabled = enabled
			saveBool("CompactTabs", enabled)
			applyCompactTabs()
		end
	)


	createToggleSetting(
		"LT_SyntaxHighlight",
		"Lua/Luau syntax highlighting",
		"Highlights Luau keywords, strings, numbers, comments, globals and built-in APIs",
		syntaxHighlightEnabled,
		function(enabled)
			syntaxHighlightEnabled = enabled
			saveBool("EditorSyntaxHighlight", enabled)
			syntaxHighlighter.applyAll()
		end
	)

	createToggleSetting(
		"LT_ExploitSyntaxHighlight",
		"Executor API highlighting",
		"Highlights common executor globals, filesystem, hook, debug and clipboard functions",
		exploitSyntaxEnabled,
		function(enabled)
			exploitSyntaxEnabled = enabled
			saveBool("ExploitSyntaxHighlight", enabled)
			syntaxHighlighter.applyAll()
		end
	)

	createToggleSetting(
		"LT_EditorWordWrap",
		"Editor word wrap",
		"Wraps long code lines inside the editor viewport",
		editorWordWrapEnabled,
		function(enabled)
			editorWordWrapEnabled = enabled
			saveBool("EditorWordWrap", enabled)
			applyEditorPreferences()
		end
	)

	createSettingRow(
		"LT_UnloadCustomization",
		"Unload customization",
		"Restores Delta's original interface and removes the active customization",
		"UNLOAD",
		function()
			local master = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaCustomizationMasterRuntime")
			if type(master) == "table" and type(master.stop) == "function" then
				task.defer(master.stop)
			else
				task.defer(runtime.stop)
			end
		end
	)

	createCycleSetting(
		"LT_EditorFontSize",
		"Editor font size",
		"Cycles the code editor font size",
		{ 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24 },
		function()
			return editorFontSize
		end,
		function(value)
			editorFontSize = value
			saveNumber("EditorFontSize", value)
			applyEditorPreferences()
		end,
		function(value)
			return tostring(value) .. " PX"
		end
	)

	connect(codeFrame.DescendantAdded, function(object)
		if object:IsA("TextBox") then
			task.defer(function()
				hookCodeBox(object)
				applyEditorStyle(object)
				queueStatusUpdate()
			end)
			task.delay(0.12, normalizeTabSequence)
		end
	end)
	local addTabButton = tabsFrame:FindFirstChild("AddTab")
	if addTabButton and addTabButton:IsA("GuiButton") then
		connect(addTabButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
			local before = #getCodeBoxes()
			task.delay(0.18, function()
				if runtime.alive and #getCodeBoxes() == before then
					createFallbackTab(nextAvailableTabName())
				end
			end)
		end)
	end
	connect(codeFrame.DescendantRemoving, function(object)
		queueStatusUpdate()
		task.delay(0.12, normalizeTabSequence)
		if not object:IsA("TextBox") or not object.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
			return
		end
		local name = object.Name
		task.delay(0.3, function()
			if
				not runtime.alive
				or not v2Main.Parent
				or not tabsFrame.Parent
				or not codeFrame.Parent
			then
				return
			end
			for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
				if box.Name == name then
					return
				end
			end
			if type(delfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" then
				local path = tabDirectory .. "/" .. name
				if isfile(path) then
					pcall(delfile, path)
				end
			end
		end)
	end)
	connect(codeFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"), updateStatusPosition)
	connect(codeFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"), updateStatusPosition)
	connect(codeFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), updateStatusPosition)
	connect(buttonsFrame.ChildAdded, function(object)
		if not object:IsA("GuiButton") then
			return
		end
		if object.Name == "Execute" or object.Name == "Clear" or object.Name == "ExecuteClipboard" then
			object:SetAttribute("LT_NativeVisible", true)
			runtime.originalButtons[object] = true
			object.Visible = true
			task.defer(function()
				if runtime.alive and object.Parent == buttonsFrame then
					buildToolbar()
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	task.wait(0.7)
	if not runtime.alive then
		return
	end
	normalizeTabSequence()
	buildToolbar()
	applyToolbarLayout()
	buildStatus()
	applyWideEditor()
	applyCompactTabs()
	applyEditorPreferences()
	syntaxHighlighter.applyAll()
	if newUi.enabled then
		newUi.enable()
	end
	if autoRestoreEnabled then
		task.spawn(restoreSavedTabs, false)
	end
end

scripts.title: Spawn pattle FTAP or Flying sandbox
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local Event = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MenuToys"):WaitForChild("SpawnToyRemoteFunction")

local targetPart = Instance.new("Part")
targetPart.Name = "NeonTargetIndicator"
targetPart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
targetPart.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)
targetPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
targetPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
targetPart.CanCollide = false
targetPart.Anchored = true
targetPart.Parent = Workspace

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        return
    end

    local camCFrame = camera.CFrame
    local lookVector = camCFrame.LookVector
    local pitch = math.asin(lookVector.Y)
    local alpha = math.clamp((-pitch) / (math.pi / 2), 0, 1)
    local fixedOffset = -0.66 + (alpha * (-14.9 - (-0.66)))

    targetPart.Position = camCFrame.Position + (lookVector * fixedOffset)
end)

local pg = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "FastUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = pg

local unlocked = true
local buttonSize = 55
local dragging = false
local dragInput
local dragStart
local startPositions = {}
local dragMoved = false
local clickThreshold = 8

local function makeButton(parent, text, size, position)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = size
    button.Position = position
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
    button.Text = text
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
    button.TextSize = 14
    button.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    button.Active = true
    button.Parent = parent

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    corner.Parent = button

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
    stroke.Thickness = 2
    stroke.Parent = button

    return button
end

local btn = makeButton(
    gui,
    "7S",
    UDim2.fromOffset(buttonSize, buttonSize),
    UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.4, 0)
)

local mainCorner = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local helper = Instance.new("Frame")
helper.Name = "HelperPanel"
helper.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 88)
helper.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, buttonSize + 10, 0.4, -16)
helper.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22)
helper.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
helper.Parent = gui

local helperCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
helperCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
helperCorner.Parent = helper

local helperStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
helperStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(65, 65, 65)
helperStroke.Thickness = 2
helperStroke.Parent = helper

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 22)
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 2)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "AJUDANTE"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 210)
title.TextSize = 13
title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
title.Parent = helper

local spawnHelper = makeButton(
    helper,
    "spawn pattle",
    UDim2.fromOffset(58, 30),
    UDim2.fromOffset(7, 32)
)

local smaller = makeButton(
    helper,
    "TAM -",
    UDim2.fromOffset(38, 30),
    UDim2.fromOffset(69, 32)
)

local bigger = makeButton(
    helper,
    "TAM +",
    UDim2.fromOffset(38, 30),
    UDim2.fromOffset(111, 32)
)

local sizeLabel = makeButton(
    helper,
    tostring(buttonSize),
    UDim2.fromOffset(43, 22),
    UDim2.fromOffset(7, 63)
)

local lockButton = makeButton(
    helper,
    "🔓",
    UDim2.fromOffset(43, 22),
    UDim2.fromOffset(54, 63)
)

local function updatePanelPosition()
    helper.Position = UDim2.new(
        btn.Position.X.Scale,
        btn.Position.X.Offset + buttonSize + 10,
        btn.Position.Y.Scale,
        btn.Position.Y.Offset - 16
    )
end

local function setSize(newSize)
    buttonSize = math.clamp(newSize, 35, 100)

    btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(buttonSize, buttonSize)
    sizeLabel.Text = tostring(buttonSize)

    updatePanelPosition()
end

local function setLocked(value)
    unlocked = not value

    if unlocked then
        lockButton.Text = "🔓"
        lockButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
        title.Text = "AJUDANTE"
    else
        lockButton.Text = "🔒"
        lockButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 45, 20)
        title.Text = "AJUDANTE - TRAVADO"
    end
end

local function spawnPallet()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then
        return
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

        local spawnPosition = targetPart.Position
        local camCFrame = camera.CFrame
        local _, yaw, _ = camCFrame:ToOrientation()

        local newCFrame = camCFrame.Rotation + spawnPosition
        local rotationVector = Vector3.new(0, math.deg(yaw), 0)

        pcall(function()
            Event:InvokeServer(
                "PalletLightBrown",
                newCFrame,
                rotationVector
            )
        end)
    end)
end

spawnHelper.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not dragMoved then
        spawnPallet()
    end
end)

smaller.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if unlocked then
        setSize(buttonSize - 5)
    end
end)

bigger.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if unlocked then
        setSize(buttonSize + 5)
    end
end)

lockButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setLocked(unlocked)
end)

local function beginDrag(input)
    if not unlocked then
        return
    end

    dragging = true
    dragMoved = false
    dragStart = input.Position

    startPositions = {
        btn = btn.Position,
        helper = helper.Position
    }

    dragInput = input
end

local function updateDrag(input)
    if not dragging or not unlocked then
        return
    end

    local delta = input.Position - dragStart

    if math.abs(delta.X) > clickThreshold
        or math.abs(delta.Y) > clickThreshold then
        dragMoved = true
    end

    if dragMoved then
        btn.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPositions.btn.X.Scale,
            startPositions.btn.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPositions.btn.Y.Scale,
            startPositions.btn.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )

        helper.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPositions.helper.X.Scale,
            startPositions.helper.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPositions.helper.Y.Scale,
            startPositions.helper.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end

local function endDrag()
    dragging = false
    dragInput = nil
end

local function connectDrag(object)
    object.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            beginDrag(input)

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    endDrag()
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    object.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            dragInput = input
        end
    end)
end

connectDrag(btn)
connectDrag(helper)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput then
        updateDrag(input)
    end
end)

-- Apertar Q spawna o pallet diretamente
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then
        return
    end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then
        spawnPallet()
    end
end)

-- O botão 7S também spawna o pallet
btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if dragMoved then
        return
    end

    spawnPallet()
end)

setLocked(false)
scripts.features: It's a script that spawns a pallet in FTP or a flying sandbox and has functions in Portuguese.
